providers.description: TRW Automotive Holdings was one of the world's largest automotive parts suppliers, specializing in active and passive safety systems including braking systems, steering systems, suspension systems, seat belts, airbags, and advanced driver assistance systems. TRW Automotive was acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen AG in 2015 and is now part of ZF Group, operating as ZF TRW. The company's automotive safety technologies are integrated across major global OEMs. TRW no longer operates an independent developer API program; developer and partner integrations are handled through ZF Group's partner ecosystem.

providers.name: Beazer Homes USA
providers.description: Beazer Homes USA, Inc. (NYSE: BZH) is an Atlanta, Georgia-headquartered national homebuilder founded in 1985 and publicly listed since 1994. The company designs, sells, and builds single-family and multi-family homes across approximately thirteen U.S. states under brand differentiators such as Choice Plans (customizable floorplans), Mortgage Choice (competitive lender program), Style Choice (interior personalization), and Livable Features (accessibility options). Beazer markets itself as "America's #1 Energy-Efficient Homebuilder," citing homes that are 44% more efficient than the average HERS-rated new home and shipping whole-house ERV ventilation in 100% of homes. As of the most recent public data point (FY2016 10-K), Beazer reported revenue of $1.822B, delivered 5,419 homes, operated 161 active communities, and employed approximately 1,100 people. The company has no public developer program or external APIs; its digital surface is a consumer-facing marketing/community-finder website plus an investor relations portal.

providers.name: Brookdale Senior Living
providers.description: Brookdale Senior Living is one of the largest operators of senior living communities in the United States, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, continuing care retirement communities (CCRCs), and in-home care through Brookdale at Home. The company operates hundreds of communities across the US, serving tens of thousands of residents and their families.

providers.name: Compass
providers.description: Compass is a leading real estate technology company headquartered in New York City that provides a tech-enabled brokerage platform connecting agents, buyers, and sellers across the United States. The company combines residential real estate services with proprietary software for agents, including marketing, client management, and listing tools. Compass does not currently publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: CVS Health
providers.description: CVS Health is a Fortune 50 healthcare services and retail pharmacy company. Its core operating units include CVS Pharmacy (retail pharmacy and mail-order), CVS Caremark (pharmacy benefit management / PBM), Aetna (health insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, dental and vision), MinuteClinic (walk-in clinics), Oak Street Health (primary care for Medicare patients), and Signify Health (in-home health evaluations). CVS Health does not currently operate a public developer portal or generally available REST API. Programmatic integrations with CVS Pharmacy, Caremark, and Aetna are typically established through business partnership agreements, EDI / NCPDP pharmacy networks, and HIPAA-aligned interoperability channels (e.g., FHIR endpoints exposed to qualifying healthcare partners under regulatory mandates such as the CMS Interoperability Rule). Developer-facing artifacts in this index are limited to public marketing, corporate, and digital health references.

providers.name: Quest Diagnostics
providers.description: Quest Diagnostics is a Fortune 500 company and the world's leading provider of diagnostic information services that patients and doctors can rely on to make better healthcare decisions. Quest operates 2,000+ patient service centers, performs 200+ million tests annually, and supplies its Quanum family of solutions for connecting laboratories, EHR systems, and health plans.

providers.name: Coty
providers.description: Coty Inc. is one of the world's largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin and body care. The company operates two divisions: Prestige (premium fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare brands such as Gucci, Burberry, Calvin Klein, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Tiffany, Chloe, Davidoff, Lancaster, philosophy, and Kylie Cosmetics) and Consumer Beauty (mass-market color cosmetics, hair care, and body care brands such as CoverGirl, Rimmel, Max Factor, Sally Hansen, Bourjois, and Adidas). Coty does not publish a public developer API; supplier and partner integrations occur through the Coty Supplier Portal and B2B / EDI channels.

providers.name: Exelon
providers.description: Exelon Corporation is one of the largest energy delivery companies in the United States, serving more than 10 million customers through its regulated electric and gas utility subsidiaries: Atlantic City Electric, BGE, ComEd, Delmarva Power, PECO, and Pepco. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, Exelon operates across multiple U.S. states. No public consumer-facing developer APIs have been identified for Exelon; customer self-service is conducted through utility portals.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble
providers.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States and the operator of the Nook digital reading platform. Barnes & Noble does not currently publish a public general-purpose developer portal. Trade and affiliate partners integrate through B&N's affiliate program, the B&N Press self-publishing platform for independent authors, EDI-based wholesale channels with publishers, and the Nook content distribution and reading ecosystem.

providers.name: Hershey
providers.description: The Hershey Company is a Fortune 500 confectionery and snacking manufacturer headquartered in Hershey, Pennsylvania, producing Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat (US), Jolly Rancher, Ice Breakers, SkinnyPop and Dot's Pretzels across North America and international markets. Hershey is a consumer packaged goods company rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API reference, and no machine-readable contract. Its public digital surface is the corporate site at thehersheycompany.com, the consumer brand site Hersheyland (hershey.com redirects there), and an investor relations site. This profile records that absence with the probes behind it, alongside press and blog coverage of the company's internal AI and data-platform investment.

providers.name: McDonald's
providers.description: McDonald's is the world's leading global foodservice retailer, operating and franchising fast food restaurants serving hamburgers, chicken, breakfast items, soft drinks, milkshakes, and desserts in countries around the world. McDonald's does not operate a public developer program or publish open API documentation. Its digital surface — the Global Mobile App, MyMcDonald's Rewards loyalty, mobile order & pay, kiosks, and drive-thru personalization — runs on internal platforms, and integrations with delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) and technology partners (Google Cloud, Dynamic Yield) are bilateral and gated to approved partners and franchisees.

providers.name: Oshkosh
providers.description: Oshkosh Corporation is a Fortune 500 industrial company that designs and builds purpose-built vehicles and vehicle bodies, including access equipment, defense vehicles, fire and emergency apparatus, refuse collection vehicles, and concrete mixers.

providers.name: Smartsign
providers.description: Smartsign (SmartSign) is a Brooklyn, New York-based e-commerce retailer of customizable signs, labels, and tags for regulatory, compliance, and safety applications, founded in 1999. It sells pre-designed and custom signage - safety, parking, traffic, property, and facility signs, plus banners and labels - online to businesses of all sizes, including a large share of the Fortune 1000 across education, healthcare, and industrial verticals. Norwest Venture Partners acquired the company in 2019 and Sentinel Capital Partners acquired it in September 2022. SmartSign operates as a business-to-business and business-to-consumer e-commerce storefront and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Elementary
providers.description: Elementary is an AI-powered machine-vision inspection company for manufacturing, founded in 2017 in South Pasadena, California (originally Elementary Robotics). Its VisionStream self-training edge AI detects production defects in seconds without rules, labeling, or tuning, while the QualityOS cloud platform delivers traceability, analytics, and MES/ERP integration across production lines. Elementary inspects over one billion parts annually for Fortune 500 manufacturers across food & beverage, automotive, consumer packaged goods, electronics, and life sciences, and is backed by Rockwell Automation, Tiger Global, Toyota Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Fika Ventures, and Idealab. The company exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: NBC
providers.description: NBC (National Broadcasting Company) is a major American commercial broadcast television network and a subsidiary of Comcast through NBCUniversal. NBC produces news (NBC News, Today), entertainment, late-night, and sports programming (Sunday Night Football, Olympic Games). NBC and parent company NBCUniversal do not publish a public developer portal. Programmatic advertising APIs (NBCUniversal One Platform) and streaming partner integrations (Peacock) are offered only through direct sales relationships rather than self-serve developer signup.

providers.name: Sanderson Farms
providers.description: Sanderson Farms was the third-largest poultry producer in the United States, producing over 13 million chickens per week before being acquired by a joint venture of Cargill and Continental Grain in 2022 to form Wayne-Sanderson Farms. Headquartered in Laurel, Mississippi, the company operated processing facilities across the southeastern United States and was a Fortune 1000 company. As a large-scale agricultural and food production enterprise, Sanderson Farms does not offer public developer APIs. The company focused on poultry processing, supply chain management, and food safety operations.

providers.name: A.Team
providers.description: A.Team is an enterprise AI talent network that connects companies with elite, pre-vetted tech builders — senior engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists — to design, build, and scale AI products and solutions. The platform matches Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups with dedicated talent and full cross-functional "expert teams," and increasingly delivers packaged AI agent solutions (voice agents, market-data and reporting agents, legal-document and due-diligence agents, municipal-code workflow agents) that integrate into existing tools like Slack, Teams, PowerPoint, and Excel. A.Team operates as a services and talent-marketplace business rather than a self-service developer API provider; it exposes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: EMCOR Group
providers.description: EMCOR Group is a Fortune 500 mechanical and electrical construction, energy, and facilities services company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut. It operates through three segments, EMCOR Construction Services, EMCOR Building Services, and EMCOR Industrial Services, delivering hyperscale data center construction, hospital support services, energy efficiency programs, and green building solutions. This repository captures the public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable artifacts associated with EMCOR Group.

providers.name: Healthpeak Properties
providers.description: Healthpeak Properties (NYSE: DOC) is an S&P 500 healthcare real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns, operates, and develops real estate for healthcare discovery and outpatient care — concentrated in lab/life-sciences, outpatient medical, and continuing care retirement community (CCRC) senior housing segments. The company tagline is "Where Discovery and Outpatient Care Thrive." Originally founded as HCP Inc. in 1985, the company rebranded to Healthpeak Properties in 2019. On March 1, 2024, Healthpeak completed an all-stock merger of equals with Physicians Realty Trust, combining two of the largest outpatient medical real estate platforms in the United States and adopting the new NYSE ticker DOC (previously PEAK). Healthpeak's portfolio spans roughly 700 properties nationwide, with lab concentrations in the South San Francisco, Boston, and San Diego clusters (including Torrey Pines Science Park and The Cove at Oyster Point) and outpatient medical assets clustered on or near top-ranked hospital campuses such as Medical City Dallas. The company reports that approximately 150,000 scientists, researchers, physicians, and healthcare professionals work in its buildings. As a healthcare REIT, Healthpeak does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or technical integration surface. Its public digital footprint is limited to corporate marketing, an investor relations site, SEC filings, ESG/sustainability reporting, and a press room. Tenant-facing operational systems (work orders, building access, energy reporting) are not exposed externally.

providers.name: HealthSouth (Encompass Health)
providers.description: HealthSouth, rebranded as Encompass Health in 2018, is one of the largest providers of post-acute healthcare services in the United States, operating inpatient rehabilitation hospitals across the country. The company focuses on rehabilitation services for stroke, neurological conditions, spinal cord injuries, and orthopedic conditions. No public developer APIs have been identified.

providers.name: Peter Kiewit Sons'
providers.description: Peter Kiewit Sons' (Kiewit Corporation) is one of North America's largest and most respected construction and engineering organizations, working on projects in transportation, water, oil, gas, power, and building markets. This repository tracks any publicly available APIs, SDKs, and developer resources for Kiewit.

providers.name: Range Resources
providers.description: Range Resources is an independent natural gas, natural gas liquids, and oil company engaged in the exploration, development, and acquisition of natural gas and oil properties primarily in the Appalachian region. Range does not publish a public developer API; this index tracks the company's public-facing digital properties for reference.

providers.name: Republic Services
providers.description: Republic Services is one of the largest providers of non-hazardous solid waste disposal, recycling, and environmental services in the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Republic Services serves millions of customers across residential, commercial, industrial, and environmental segments. The company offers waste collection, recycling processing, composting, landfill operations, and digital customer tools for account management, service scheduling, and environmental reporting.

providers.name: CHS
providers.description: CHS Inc. is a Fortune 500 diversified, integrated, global agricultural cooperative owned by farmers, ranchers, cooperatives, and individual producers. Headquartered in Inver Grove Heights, Minnesota, CHS describes itself as the largest farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, with more than 750 member cooperatives, 75,000+ individual producer-owners, and 20,000+ preferred stockholders. The cooperative serves customers in 65 countries through three primary business divisions: Agriculture (crop nutrients, crop protection, precision agriculture, seed, animal nutrition, and oilseed products), Energy (refined fuels, propane, lubricants, pipelines, terminals, and renewable fuels under the Cenex brand), and Services (hedging, payment solutions, transportation, and capital services). Major brands include Cenex, Allegiant (seed), Payback (animal nutrition), and N-Edge (crop nutrients). CHS does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are provided through digital platforms such as MyCHS (online portal for grain tickets, billing, and payments) and CHS Connect (digital self-service for crop protection and energy wholesale customers).

providers.name: Constellation Energy
providers.description: Constellation Energy Corporation is a Fortune 500 clean-energy producer and competitive retail electricity and natural gas supplier in the United States, generating power from a fleet of nuclear, hydro, wind, and solar facilities. Constellation does not publish a public developer portal; programmatic interactions are delivered to enterprise and large commercial customers through the Energy Manager platform (account-managed onboarding, no public API specifications) and consumer interactions are handled through the My Constellation account portal. EDI 867 (usage) and 810 (invoice) remain the most common machine-to-machine integration paths and are arranged on a contract-by-contract basis.

providers.name: Eastman Chemical
providers.description: Driven by more than 100 years of continuous innovation, Eastman is a global Fortune 500 specialty materials company that produces a broad range of advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers used in everyday products. Eastman operates a customer-facing Customer Center for orders, documents, and Safety Data Sheets, but no public developer portal or REST API has been documented.

providers.name: NGL Energy Partners
providers.description: NGL Energy Partners LP is a diversified midstream master limited partnership providing transportation, storage, blending, and marketing services for crude oil, natural gas liquids, refined products, and water solutions to producers and end-users across the energy industry. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol NGL and operates three primary business units: Crude Oil Logistics, Water Solutions, and NGL Liquids.

providers.name: XPO Logistics
providers.description: XPO Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation in North America. The company offers freight transportation through a proprietary network of service centers and uses technology to drive efficiency for more than 50,000 customers. XPO Logistics historically operated as part of XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO), the publicly traded company that spun off GXO Logistics (contract logistics) in 2021 and RXO (brokerage) in 2022, leaving XPO focused on LTL trucking. XPO Logistics does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged through enterprise account managers.

providers.name: Agilon Health
providers.description: Agilon Health is a healthcare services company that partners with primary care physicians to transform care for seniors through a value-based, total care model. The company supports physician groups with a platform that combines clinical, operational, and financial capabilities to manage Medicare populations. Agilon Health does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Fossil Group
providers.description: Fossil Group is a global designer, marketer, and distributor of consumer fashion accessories including watches, jewelry, handbags, small leather goods, belts, and sunglasses sold under owned and licensed brands such as Fossil, Skagen, Michele, Relic, Misfit, and licensed lines for Michael Kors, Diesel, Emporio Armani, Tory Burch, and others.

providers.name: General Electric
providers.description: General Electric Company has reorganized into separate publicly traded companies: GE Aerospace, focused on jet engines and aviation systems, and GE Vernova, focused on energy and power generation. GE HealthCare was spun off in 2023. No unified public developer API portal is currently published by GE Aerospace or GE Vernova.

providers.name: HCA Healthcare
providers.description: HCA Healthcare (formerly HCA Holdings) is one of the largest for-profit operators of healthcare facilities in the world, operating hospitals, surgery centers, freestanding emergency rooms, and urgent care centers. The company was named HCA Holdings until May 2017. No public developer portal or production APIs are advertised.

providers.name: International Game Technology
providers.description: International Game Technology (IGT) is a global gaming company that delivers entertaining and responsible gaming experiences across all gaming channels and regulated segments, including lottery, gaming machines, sports betting, and digital gaming. IGT does not currently offer a public developer API program; its technical resources are delivered through licensed B2B partner channels.

providers.name: Las Vegas Sands
providers.description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is the world's leading developer and operator of integrated resorts, including The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas (divested in 2022) and Marina Bay Sands in Singapore. The company operates in the casino, hospitality, convention, and entertainment industries.

providers.name: Moog
providers.description: Moog Inc. is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and integrator of precision motion and fluid control products and solutions for aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical applications. Product divisions include actuation, motion systems, motors, propulsion, valves, aerospace components, and defense systems. Moog does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Hyatt Hotels
providers.description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) is a Chicago-headquartered global hospitality company that develops, owns, operates, manages, franchises and licenses hotels, resorts, branded residences and vacation-ownership properties across brands including Park Hyatt, Grand Hyatt, Hyatt Regency, Andaz, Alila, Thompson Hotels, Hyatt Centric, Hyatt Place, Hyatt House and Miraval. No Hyatt developer portal, API reference, machine-readable contract or first-party SDK was found on any reachable Hyatt host or in any public registry as of September 2026; api.hyatt.com resolves to a live but undocumented gateway, and hyatt.com sits behind an edge bot challenge no automated client can read. Partner connectivity runs through third parties (Hapi for event streams and transactional APIs, Sabre SynXis for reservations), and Hyatt's conversational surface ships as a Hyatt-branded app inside ChatGPT rather than an endpoint Hyatt hosts. Hyatt has run a public HackerOne bug bounty program since January 2019.

providers.name: Lazard
providers.description: Lazard is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Lazard API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Liberty Energy
providers.description: Liberty Energy is a North American oilfield services company providing hydraulic fracturing, wireline, sand logistics, and power generation services to onshore exploration and production operators. The company also develops technology solutions for energy completion, ESG reporting, and natural gas fueling. Liberty Energy does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: McKesson
providers.description: McKesson is a Fortune 500 healthcare company providing wholesale medical supplies and equipment, pharmaceutical distribution, and healthcare technology solutions. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble Education
providers.description: Barnes & Noble Education, Inc. (NYSE: BNED) is one of the largest operators of college bookstores in the United States, operating physical and virtual campus stores alongside digital course-materials and educational services. BNED reaches more than 5.7 million students through 1,125+ physical and virtual stores across higher education and K-12 institutions, primarily through its Barnes & Noble College Booksellers subsidiary and the MBS Textbook Exchange wholesale business. Flagship offerings include the First Day and First Day Complete affordable-access course-materials programs, BNC OER+ digital courseware, faculty adoption tools, campus retail and ecommerce services, and BNC AI Tools. BNED separated from Barnes & Noble, Inc. in August 2015 and is not affiliated with the Barnes & Noble retail bookstore chain. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with BNED. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time; integrations with campus systems and learning-management systems are delivered through institutional partnerships rather than a public API surface.

providers.name: Digitalhealthstrategies
providers.description: Digital Health Strategies (DHS) is a digital marketing and online fundraising firm focused on healthcare organizations. Founded in 2014, DHS combines Fortune 500 precision with healthcare empathy to help hospitals, health systems, and patient advocacy groups grow their patient activation and engagement. The company offers services such as service line growth, brand strategy, and digital fundraising, aiming to improve health outcomes through strategic communication and technology.

providers.name: Owens Corning
providers.description: Owens Corning is a global Fortune 500 building and industrial materials leader committed to building a sustainable future through material innovation, providing roofing, insulation, composite materials, and doors. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
providers.description: Bio-Rad Laboratories is a global leader in developing and manufacturing a wide range of products for the life science research and clinical diagnostic markets, including instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services. Founded in 1952, Bio-Rad serves scientists in genomics, proteomics, cell biology, quality control, and clinical diagnostics with products like real-time PCR systems, western blotting instruments, flow cytometers, and digital PCR.

providers.name: Bug Labs
providers.description: Bug Labs is a New York City enterprise software company founded in 2006, first as one of the earliest open-source modular hardware makers and later as an enterprise IoT platform provider serving Fortune 500 customers including Verizon, Comcast, VMware, Ford, Charter and Orange. Its current flagship product, Signalpattern, targets workflow fragmentation by mapping and connecting dispersed enterprise systems, automating cross-system tasks, and letting users interact with APIs directly without writing code. Bug Labs previously operated the well-known public IoT APIs dweet.io, dweetpro.io and freeboard.io; all three are decommissioned and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation or public API today. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Spark Capital and Court Square Ventures.

providers.name: ConocoPhillips
providers.description: ConocoPhillips is a leading global exploration and production company, headquartered in Houston, Texas, that is uniquely equipped to deliver reliable, responsibly produced oil and natural gas. The company operates in more than a dozen countries with conventional and unconventional crude oil, natural gas, LNG, and natural gas liquids assets. ConocoPhillips does not publish public developer APIs; its external digital surface is organized around an investor relations portal, a vendor relations portal (powered by third-party platforms such as GEP and Taulia), an LNG technology and licensing program, and a custom sustainability report builder.

providers.name: EchoStar
providers.description: EchoStar Corporation (Nasdaq: SATS) is a global, fully integrated communications and content delivery leader and provider of technology, spectrum, and connectivity. Through its DISH, Boost Mobile, Hughes, and EchoStar Mobile brands, EchoStar delivers satellite communications, wireless services, and IoT connectivity to consumers, enterprises, governments, and aviation customers worldwide.

providers.name: GE HealthCare Technologies
providers.description: GE HealthCare Technologies (NASDAQ: GEHC) is a global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator providing imaging, ultrasound, patient care solutions, and pharmaceutical diagnostics. Spun off from General Electric in January 2023 and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

providers.name: Sonic Automotive
providers.description: Sonic Automotive is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating 100+ franchise dealerships across 13 states representing 25+ automotive brands, and operating EchoPark Automotive used-vehicle stores. The company invests in digital retail, inventory management technology, and automotive data platforms to enhance customer experience across vehicle sales, service, finance, and insurance. Technology partners include Stripe, NETSOL, and CDK Global.

providers.name: Sonoco Products
providers.description: Sonoco Products Company is a global leader in sustainable metal and fiber consumer and industrial packaging, operating 285 facilities across 40 countries with 23,000+ employees. Products include metal packaging (aerosol cans, steel food cans, closures), rigid paper packaging (paper containers, fiber cartridges), industrial paper packaging (tubes, cores, recycled paperboard), and industrial specialty packaging (plastic components, reels, spools). Serves food and beverage, pet care, household products, beauty, automotive, and industrial markets. A Fortune 500 company (NYSE: SON).

providers.name: VF Corporation
providers.description: VF Corporation is a global apparel and footwear company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. VF owns major brands including Vans, The North Face, Timberland, Altra, Eastpak, Icebreaker, JanSport, Kipling, Napapijri, and Smartwool. The company does not offer a public developer API program; its technology integrations are handled through third-party e-commerce platforms and enterprise supply chain systems. VF Corporation operates more than 1,500 stores globally and integrates with platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, Magento, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce via third-party integration services.

providers.name: DISH Network
providers.description: DISH Network is a U.S. television provider offering satellite and streaming TV services, as well as wireless services through its Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless brands. DISH is now part of EchoStar following the 2024 merger that brought DISH and Hughes back together under one parent. No public consumer-facing developer APIs are documented; the Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless networks are operated on a 5G Open RAN architecture.

providers.name: Dollar Tree
providers.description: Dollar Tree is a leading operator of discount variety stores in North America, operating more than 16,000 stores under the Dollar Tree and Family Dollar banners. Vendor and supplier integration is primarily handled through EDI, SAP, and ERP systems via the Dollar Tree Vendor Portal. No public REST API is currently available.

providers.name: Applied Materials
providers.description: Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMAT) is the global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world, supplying deposition, etch, chemical mechanical planarization, ion implantation, metrology and inspection equipment to semiconductor, display and adjacent markets. Its Applied SmartFactory business unit (appliedsmartfactory.com) ships the software side of that portfolio - PROMIS and 300works MES, SPC and process-quality, scheduling, dispatching and material-control products for fabs. Applied Materials publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable API contract; software is delivered under enterprise licence and support runs through customer portals.

providers.name: Diamondback Energy
providers.description: Diamondback Energy is an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin of West Texas. As a Fortune 500 company in the upstream energy sector, Diamondback publishes no developer portal, no API, and no machine-readable contract of any kind; its entire web presence is a Q4/gcs-web investor-relations site, and owner joint-interest billing and revenue check detail are delivered through the third-party EnergyLink portal rather than a first-party interface. The only machine-readable surfaces it serves are three RSS feeds on the IR platform — news releases, events and SEC filings. This repository is maintained as a placeholder for any APIs, developer tools, or machine-readable artifacts that may emerge.

providers.name: Autoliv
providers.description: Autoliv is the world's largest automotive safety supplier, designing, manufacturing, and selling airbags, seatbelts, steering wheels, inflators, pyrotechnic actuators, and related safety electronics for vehicle manufacturers worldwide. The company operates in 25 countries with 13 technology centers and serves all major OEMs.

providers.name: NuStar Energy
providers.description: NuStar Energy was one of the largest independent liquids terminal and pipeline operators in the United States, transporting and storing crude oil, refined products, and renewable fuels. Sunoco LP completed its acquisition of NuStar on 3 May 2024, and nustarenergy.com now redirects to sunocolp.com. NuStar published no public APIs or developer resources.

providers.name: Papa John's International
providers.description: Papa John's International, Inc. is a major US-based quick-service pizza restaurant chain and Fortune 1000 company operating company-owned and franchised locations worldwide. Papa John's runs consumer-facing online ordering, a Papa Rewards loyalty program, and mobile apps, and integrates with third-party delivery aggregators and restaurant-technology platforms. Papa John's does NOT publish a public developer API or developer portal; its technology surface is internal, franchise-facing, and partner-only. Integrations are arranged through enterprise and franchise partner agreements.

providers.name: Western Refining
providers.description: Western Refining was an independent crude oil refiner and marketer of refined petroleum products headquartered in El Paso, Texas. The company operated refineries in El Paso, Texas; Gallup, New Mexico; and St. Paul Park, Minnesota before being acquired by Tesoro Corporation in 2017 for approximately $6.4 billion. Western Refining's assets are now part of Andeavor (formerly Tesoro), subsequently acquired by Marathon Petroleum in 2018.

providers.name: WestRock
providers.description: WestRock (now Smurfit Westrock following its 2024 merger with Smurfit Kappa) is one of the world's largest paper and packaging companies. The company provides differentiated paper and packaging solutions including corrugated containers, consumer packaging, displays, and specialty packaging. WestRock serves consumer and industrial markets with an integrated supply chain connecting mills, converting operations, and customers globally.

providers.name: eXp World Holdings
providers.description: eXp World Holdings is the holding company for a portfolio of cloud-based, agent-centric real estate and technology businesses including eXp Realty, eXp Commercial, SUCCESS magazine, Frame, Realty Connect, and LuxVT. The company operates a virtual brokerage model powered by an immersive cloud workspace for agents. eXp World Holdings does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Exxon Mobil
providers.description: Exxon Mobil Corporation is one of the world's largest publicly traded international energy companies, exploring for, producing, and refining oil and natural gas and manufacturing petroleum and chemical products. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with Exxon Mobil.

providers.name: T. Rowe Price
providers.description: T. Rowe Price is a global asset management firm (NYSE: TROW) offering a broad range of investment management strategies and retirement solutions to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. Founded in 1937, the firm manages mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts, and retirement plans including 401(k) services. T. Rowe Price does not offer a public REST API but provides institutional client portals, data feeds, and integrations with retirement recordkeeping platforms and open banking aggregators such as Plaid and Finicity.

providers.name: Fortive
providers.description: Fortive Corporation is a Fortune 500 diversified industrial technology conglomerate headquartered in Everett, Washington. The company operates across two main segments, Advanced Healthcare Solutions and Intelligent Operating Solutions, providing essential technologies for medical device safety, radiation protection, workflow automation, hazard detection, and predictive maintenance through its operating companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fortive at the parent company level. Most APIs and developer resources are maintained by Fortive's individual operating companies.

providers.name: Lincoln Electric Holdings
providers.description: Lincoln Electric Holdings is a global manufacturer of arc welding products, robotic welding systems, plasma and oxyfuel cutting equipment, and brazing and soldering alloys. The company also offers connected welding solutions and equipment monitoring software for industrial environments.

providers.name: Organon
providers.description: Organon & Co. is a Fortune 500 global healthcare company focused on improving the health of women throughout their lives. Spun off from Merck in 2021, Organon's portfolio spans women's health, biosimilars, and established medicines across more than 140 markets worldwide. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Organon. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Playtika Holding
providers.description: Playtika Holding is an Israel-based mobile gaming company and Fortune 1000 firm that develops and publishes free-to-play casual and casino-themed games such as Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, and Caesars Slots. The company operates a portfolio of social and casual mobile gaming titles distributed through major app stores and uses data-driven engagement and live operations to monetize its global player base. Playtika does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

providers.name: Domtar
providers.description: Domtar is committed to turning responsibly sourced wood fiber into essential products like paper, pulp, recycled packaging, tissue, and lumber. No public developer-facing APIs have been identified at this time; this index will be updated if any are made available.

providers.name: Topgolf Callaway Brands
providers.description: Topgolf Callaway Brands is a global golf and entertainment company that designs, manufactures, and sells golf clubs, balls, apparel, and accessories under the Callaway, Odyssey, OGIO, TravisMathew, and Jack Wolfskin brands, and operates Topgolf entertainment venues and the Toptracer ball-tracking technology. Topgolf Callaway Brands does not publish a single public developer API portal, though Toptracer ball-tracking technology is licensed to driving ranges through a separate commercial program.

providers.name: Costco Wholesale
providers.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation is a Fortune 500 American multinational membership-only big-box retail chain that operates warehouse clubs offering a wide selection of merchandise at discounted prices. Costco does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading partner integrations are conducted through EDI and B2B channels using ANSI X12 transactions and the Costco Supplier Portal. Costco operates an e-commerce site, the Costco Travel and Costco Pharmacy properties, and the Costco Photo Center.

providers.name: Owens & Minor
providers.description: Owens & Minor is a global Fortune 500 healthcare solutions company providing essential products and services to healthcare providers and manufacturers across the continuum of care, including medical and surgical supplies distribution, home healthcare equipment (Apria, Byram Healthcare), and outsourced logistics. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: D.R. Horton
providers.description: D.R. Horton is the largest homebuilder by volume in the United States, building and selling single-family homes in dozens of states across multiple price points. The company is a Fortune 500 enterprise with affiliated financial services including DHI Mortgage, DHI Title, and DRH Insurance.

providers.name: MSC Industrial Direct
providers.description: MSC Industrial Direct is one of the largest industrial product distributors in North America, providing metalworking, maintenance, repair, and operations products and services to manufacturers.

providers.name: OneMain Holdings
providers.description: OneMain Holdings is a leading provider of personal installment loans to nonprime consumers in the United States, with branches across multiple states. No public APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: PetSmart
providers.description: PetSmart is a North American chain of retail stores selling specialty pet supplies, services, and small companion animals. This repository tracks any publicly available APIs, SDKs, and developer resources for PetSmart.

providers.name: HiddenLayer
providers.description: HiddenLayer is an Austin, Texas-based AI security company founded in March 2022 by Chris Sestito (CEO), Tanner Burns (Chief Scientist), and Jim Ballard (CIO) — former Cylance researchers who encountered a real-world attack on production ML models. HiddenLayer builds an AI Security Platform that protects machine learning and generative AI systems across their entire lifecycle, comprising four integrated modules: AI Discovery (catalogs AI assets and eliminates shadow AI), AI Supply Chain Security (Model Scanner inspects models, weights, and pickle/RDS files for malicious payloads and backdoors), AI Attack Simulation (continuous adversarial red-teaming for agentic and generative systems), and AI Runtime Security / AIDR (a real-time detection-and-response firewall using deterministic classifiers that sit outside the model inference path to detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect attacks, data leakage, and malicious tool calls in agentic and MCP systems). The platform exposes native connectors for CI/CD, MLOps, SIEM/SOAR, API gateways, and major data and cloud platforms, plus guardrail integrations for OpenAI Agents, LangChain, AWS Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure APIM, and a GitHub Action for Model Scanner. HiddenLayer publishes Python, TypeScript, and Java/Kotlin SDKs and research-grade tooling such as HiddenPickle (Python pickle disassembler/patcher) and HiddenPromise (R .rdx/.rdb/.rds disassembler). The company has raised $56M total ($50M Series A in September 2023 led by M12 / Microsoft's Venture Fund and Moore Strategic Ventures, with Booz Allen Ventures, IBM Ventures, Capital One Ventures, and Ten Eleven Ventures participating) and serves Fortune 500 enterprises, financial services, and US Federal agencies. The HiddenLayer SaaS console and REST API are gated behind enterprise sales and not publicly self-serve, placing this profile in Tier-3 (enterprise-gated) coverage.

providers.name: Lexmark International
providers.description: Lexmark International is a global imaging and IoT solutions leader that helps customers worldwide realize the full potential of their information through printers, multifunction devices, and managed print services. As of 2024, Lexmark was acquired by Xerox Holdings Corporation. Public developer APIs are not currently advertised through an open developer portal.

providers.name: Marvell Technology
providers.description: Marvell Technology, Inc. is a Fortune 500 fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company designs and develops data infrastructure semiconductor solutions including custom ASICs, data processing units, Ethernet controllers, optical and copper PHYs, switches, and storage controllers used in data centers, enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, automotive, and consumer markets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Marvell. Public developer documentation is gated behind a customer support portal and is not openly accessible.

providers.name: Viacom
providers.description: Viacom was an American mass media conglomerate that merged with CBS Corporation in December 2019 to form ViacomCBS (later rebranded as Paramount Global). The combined entity, which included brands such as CBS, MTV, Nickelodeon, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount Pictures, Showtime, and Paramount+, was subsequently acquired by Skydance Media and ceased to exist as an independent public company in August 2025. Viacom maintained open source software through its GitHub organization (ViacomInc), including tools for Roku channel development, tvOS UI components, and broadcast calendar utilities. No public external developer API program was offered.

providers.name: Host Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: Host Hotels & Resorts is a leading lodging real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns luxury and upper-upscale hotels operating under premium brands in major U.S. and international markets. No public APIs are offered.

providers.name: Leggett and Platt
providers.description: Leggett and Platt is a diversified manufacturer that designs and produces engineered components and products found in many homes, offices, vehicles, and aircraft, including bedding components, automotive seating, hydraulic cylinders, and aerospace tube assemblies. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Owens-Illinois (O-I Glass)
providers.description: Owens-Illinois (now O-I Glass) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of glass containers, supplying glass packaging to the food, beverage, beer, wine, spirits, and pharmaceutical industries. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Celanese
providers.description: Celanese Corporation is a global chemical and specialty materials company that produces high-performance engineered polymers and acetyl products used across automotive, medical, consumer, and industrial applications. Celanese has no publicly documented developer API; digital engagement is delivered through the Chemille digital materials assistant for product search and selection, and a Cognite Data Fusion based manufacturing data platform for internal operations.

providers.name: CIT Group
providers.description: CIT Group was a US financial holding company providing commercial financing, equipment leasing, factoring, and middle-market banking services. CIT was acquired by First Citizens BancShares in January 2022 and has been integrated into First Citizens Bank as the Commercial Banking division. CIT Group does not maintain a public developer portal and never published general-purpose REST APIs; legacy customer integrations were delivered through file-based ACH/wire feeds, the OneWest online banking platform, and partner-mediated treasury connectivity. New API-based integrations for the combined institution are now exposed through First Citizens Bank.

providers.name: IDEX
providers.description: IDEX Corporation (NYSE: IEX) is a global engineered products company that designs and manufactures pumps, flow meters, valves, fluidics systems, precision components, and fire and safety equipment. IDEX serves health, science, water, energy, semiconductor, aerospace, fire and safety, and industrial markets through three segments: Fluid and Metering Technologies, Health and Science Technologies, and Fire and Safety / Diversified Products.

providers.name: Cooper Tire & Rubber
providers.description: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company is an American manufacturer of replacement tires for passenger cars, light trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles, founded in 1914 and headquartered in Findlay, Ohio. Cooper was acquired by The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company in June 2021 and now operates as a subsidiary, retaining the Cooper brand alongside Goodyear. The Cooper brand portfolio covers all-season, winter, all-terrain, and sport performance tires distributed through retailers and dealers worldwide. Cooper Tire does not publish a public developer program or REST APIs. Its digital presence is consumer-facing tire selection, retailer locators, and post-purchase tire registration.

providers.name: Mu Sigma
providers.description: Mu Sigma is a decision sciences and AI services company founded in 2004, headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois with its principal delivery centre in Bangalore, India, working with 140+ Fortune 500 clients across retail, pharma, financial services, manufacturing, energy, technology and logistics. Its work is delivered as engagements and platforms rather than as a public developer product: the Art of Problem Solving System (muAoPS), the Akashic Architecture enterprise intelligence foundation, the muTalos agentic-AI ecosystem, Enablers of Confidence, and a Continuous Service-as-a-Software operating model. Mu Sigma publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract; its only public machine-readable engineering output is a set of open-source R packages for decision science (HVT, muHVT, analysisPipelines, RImpala, Rdrools) released to CRAN from the github.com/Mu-Sigma organization.

providers.name: New Residential Investment Corp (Rithm Capital)
providers.description: New Residential Investment Corp (NYSE: NRZ) was a mortgage real estate investment trust (REIT) that **rebranded as Rithm Capital Corp (NYSE: RITM) in August 2022** to reflect its evolution from a pure mortgage REIT into a diversified global asset manager focused on real estate, credit, and financial services. Rithm Capital is headquartered in New York City, led by Chairman & CEO Michael Nierenberg, and as of 2024 reported approximately $46 billion in assets under management, ~$5.2 billion in revenue, and ~6,045 employees across its operating businesses (Newrez mortgage origination/servicing, Genesis Capital business-purpose lending, Sculptor Capital Management alternatives platform, Rithm Property Trust REIT [formerly Great Ajax], Adoor single-family rental, Crestline credit, and Elecor Properties [formerly Paramount Group] office real estate). This profile carries forward the legacy `new-residential-investment` repo identity under the API Evangelist network. The active corporate identity, public filings, and investor communications are at rithmcap.com. Rithm Capital and its subsidiaries operate as financial-services businesses serving institutional investors, mortgage borrowers, and real-estate sponsors. None of the public-facing Rithm Capital, Newrez, Genesis Capital, Sculptor, Rithm Property Trust, Adoor, Crestline, or Elecor Properties websites expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, REST/GraphQL API, SDK, CLI, webhook system, status page, or RSS feed. There are no public GitHub organizations of substance for any of the brand surfaces (the `newrez` GitHub org exists with zero public repositories; `rithmcap` does not exist). Integration with these businesses occurs through traditional B2B mortgage / capital-markets channels, not a public API surface.

providers.name: Nordstrom
providers.description: Nordstrom is a leading fashion retailer offering compelling clothing, shoes, and accessories for men, women, and children through Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack stores and online. Nordstrom does not currently operate a public developer portal or expose general-purpose APIs to third-party developers; this repository captures the company profile and any future developer-facing artifacts.

providers.name: onsemi
providers.description: ON Semiconductor (now branded as onsemi) is a global supplier of semiconductor-based solutions for power efficiency, image sensing, and signal processing in automotive, industrial, and other applications. No public APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Wolverine World Wide
providers.description: Wolverine World Wide is a leading designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded footwear, apparel, and accessories. Brands include Merrell, Saucony, Wolverine, Sperry, Sweaty Betty, and Hush Puppies. The company operates global wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and digital commerce channels. Wolverine World Wide does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Brown-Forman
providers.description: Brown-Forman Corporation is one of the largest American-owned spirits and wine companies in the world, established in 1870 and headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The company produces, bottles, imports, exports, markets, and sells a wide variety of alcoholic beverages under brands including Jack Daniel's, Woodford Reserve, Old Forester, Herradura, El Jimador, Slane Irish Whiskey, Benriach, Chambord, Diplomático, and Ford's Gin. Brown-Forman is traded on the NYSE under tickers BF.A and BF.B.

providers.name: Comfort Systems USA
providers.description: Comfort Systems USA (NYSE: FIX) is a Houston-based mechanical, electrical and plumbing contractor — one of the largest in the United States — that installs, services and maintains HVAC, piping, electrical and building-automation systems for commercial, industrial and institutional buildings through more than 45 operating companies in over 170 locations. Its business lines are construction (engineering and design, prefabrication, virtual construction), modular and off-site construction, building services (maintenance, on-demand and retrofit) and building automation (controls, monitoring, security and energy management). The company publishes no public API, developer program, SDK or machine-readable contract; its web presence is a WordPress marketing site and an investor-relations site.

providers.name: Discovery Communications
providers.description: Discovery Communications was a global media company providing original and purchased programming across multiple distribution platforms before merging with WarnerMedia in 2022 to form Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), a leading global media and entertainment company whose portfolio spans HBO Max, Discovery Channel, CNN, Warner Bros. film studios, DC, Food Network, HGTV, and other television, film, and streaming brands. No public developer APIs are documented at the corporate level; technical and partnership inquiries are handled at the individual brand or business-unit level.

providers.name: J.C. Penney
providers.description: J.C. Penney Company, Inc. (JCPenney) is an American department store chain offering apparel, accessories, beauty, jewelry, footwear, and home goods. The company emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy in late 2020 and continues to operate hundreds of department stores across the United States and Puerto Rico.

providers.name: Kyndryl
providers.description: Kyndryl is a Fortune 500 IT infrastructure services company spun off from IBM in 2021. The company designs, builds, manages, and modernizes mission-critical technology systems across cloud, mainframe, networking, digital workplace, security, applications, data, and AI. Kyndryl operates the Kyndryl Bridge integration and observability platform, runs the Kyndryl Vital design studios, and partners with hyperscalers including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and SAP. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: L-3 Communications
providers.description: L-3 Communications was a U.S. defense prime contractor specializing in command, control, communications, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (C3ISR) systems, aircraft modernization and maintenance, and government services. In 2019 L-3 merged with Harris Corporation to form L3Harris Technologies, which continues the legacy product lines and is now ranked among the top U.S. defense contractors. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Leidos
providers.description: Leidos, a Fortune 500 digital and mission innovator, delivers solutions at the intersection of national security, health, and critical infrastructure. With a global workforce of approximately 47,000, the company is executing its NorthStar 2030 strategy focused on five growth engines: space and maritime, energy infrastructure, digital modernization and cyber, mission software, and managed health. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Nestlé
providers.description: Nestlé S.A. is the world's largest food and beverage company by revenue, headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland. Its product portfolio spans coffee (Nescafé, Nespresso), water, pet food (Purina), baby and infant nutrition (Gerber, Cerelac), confectionery (KitKat), dairy, and health science. No public developer portal or external API offering has been identified for Nestlé; integrations with retailers and partners are handled through private B2B systems rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Plexus

Plexus does not currently publish a public developer API; this index tracks customer/supplier portals and corporate web properties.

providers.name: Service Properties Trust
providers.description: Service Properties Trust (NASDAQ: SVC) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) with approximately $9.9 billion invested across two asset categories: service-focused retail net lease properties and hotels.
