The company is externally managed by The RMR Group (NASDAQ: RMR). SVC does not operate a public developer program and exposes no public APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or webhooks; investor-facing endpoints are limited to SEC filings, press releases, email alerts, and end-of-day stock quotes.

providers.name: Twenty-First Century Fox
providers.description: Twenty-First Century Fox was an American multinational mass media corporation that operated film, television, and cable assets before being largely acquired by The Walt Disney Company in 2019. Its remaining broadcasting and news assets continued under Fox Corporation. The company no longer exists as an independent entity and did not expose public developer APIs.

providers.name: LifePoint Health
providers.description: LifePoint Health is a leading healthcare provider operating community hospitals, regional health systems, physician practices, outpatient centers, and post-acute facilities across the United States. This index tracks any APIs, SDKs, and developer resources published by LifePoint Health.

providers.name: Team Health Holdings
providers.description: TeamHealth Holdings is one of the largest physician practice organizations in the United States, providing outsourced healthcare professional staffing and administrative services to hospitals and other healthcare providers. Through more than 15,000 affiliated healthcare professionals and advanced practice clinicians, TeamHealth offers emergency medicine, hospital medicine, critical care, anesthesiology, orthopedic surgery, general surgery, obstetrics, ambulatory care, post-acute care, and medical call center solutions to approximately 3,000 acute and post-acute facilities and physician groups nationwide. TeamHealth does not maintain a public-facing developer API.

providers.name: Tupperware Brands
providers.description: Tupperware Brands Corporation was an American multinational consumer goods company that manufactured and marketed premium kitchen storage, preparation, and serving products under the Tupperware brand, as well as related home product lines. The company distributed products to approximately 70 countries through independent sales force members. Tupperware Brands filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2024 and underwent liquidation in 2025. The Tupperware brand name was subsequently acquired by Party Products LLC. No public developer API program was available during the company's operation.

providers.name: Calpine
providers.description: Calpine Corporation was a major U.S. energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas, and was the largest generator of electricity from natural gas and geothermal energy in the United States. It operated 80 power plants with approximately 26,035 megawatts of generation capacity, including The Geysers, the world's largest geothermal complex. Calpine also operated the Champion Energy retail electricity subsidiary serving deregulated markets. As of January 2026, Constellation Energy completed its acquisition of Calpine for $16.4 billion, making it a business unit of Constellation. Calpine does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Core & Main
providers.description: Core & Main is a leading specialty distributor of water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection products and related services to municipalities, contractors, and engineers across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Core & Main operates more than 320 branch locations and provides products and services for water infrastructure, geosynthetics, fusible HDPE pipe, smart metering, fire protection, and erosion control.

providers.name: Darling Ingredients
providers.description: Darling Ingredients is a global developer and producer of sustainable natural ingredients from edible and inedible bio-nutrients, creating products for the food, pet food, feed, fuel, bioenergy, and fertilizer industries. Darling operates Diamond Green Diesel as a renewable diesel joint venture with Valero, and brands such as Rousselot (gelatin and collagen), Sonac, CTH, and EnviroFlight. Darling does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Kyros College Prep
providers.description: Kyros (kyros.ai) is an AI-driven college preparation and admissions platform. In the company's own words, it is "a College Prep Platform by former Googlers, Admissions Officers, and Professors" that "uses AI to offer 100K+ summer and financial aid programs." The product combines student assessments for college and major fit, one-on-one counseling, college essay and letter-of-recommendation support, extracurricular and summer-program discovery, and structured program tracks such as Future You Lab, the UC Bootcamp, and industry immersion and research programs. Kyros also sells through partner channels, with education-partner, VAR, counselor-advisory, college-success, and Fortune 1000 employer offerings, and publishes a large admissions blog. As of 2026-07-19 Kyros publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: MDU Resources Group
providers.description: MDU Resources Group is a diversified natural resources company with operations in regulated energy delivery, construction materials, and construction services. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: New Jersey Resources
providers.description: New Jersey Resources (NJR) is a Fortune 1000 energy services holding company that provides natural gas distribution through New Jersey Natural Gas, retail energy services, midstream assets, and clean energy investments. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Phillips 66
providers.description: Phillips 66 is a diversified energy manufacturing and logistics company with midstream, chemicals, refining, and marketing and specialties businesses. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for Phillips 66.

providers.name: USG
providers.description: USG Corporation is a leading manufacturer of building products and innovative solutions for the construction industry. USG produces Sheetrock brand drywall, Durock cement board, Securock glass-mat sheathing, and a wide range of interior finishing systems. The company serves contractors, architects, and building professionals through its distributor network and provides digital tools and APIs to support the building and construction workflow.

providers.name: Celgene
providers.description: Celgene Corporation was a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for cancer and immune-inflammatory diseases. Celgene was acquired by Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) in November 2019 and its operations are now consolidated under BMS. No public developer API has been identified; engagement is organized through BMS clinical trials, study connect, and investigator-sponsored research portals.

providers.name: Cummins
providers.description: Cummins is a global power leader that designs, manufactures, distributes, and services diesel and natural gas engines, electric and hybrid powertrains, electrified power systems, components such as filtration, aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, controls systems, air handling systems, automated transmissions, and electric power generation systems. Cummins serves customers in approximately 190 countries and territories through a network of more than 600 company-owned and independent distributor locations and approximately 7,200 dealer locations.

providers.name: Granite Construction
providers.description: Granite Construction is one of the largest diversified heavy civil contractors and construction materials producers in the United States, with operations spanning transportation infrastructure, water infrastructure, mineral exploration, and aggregate materials.

providers.name: iHeartMedia
providers.description: iHeartMedia is America's #1 audio company, reaching 9 out of 10 Americans every month through broadcast radio, digital streaming, podcasts, live events, and on-demand entertainment. Public API documentation, developer programs, or open API artifacts have not been identified for iHeartMedia. This repository exists to track APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: Jacobs Engineering Group
providers.description: Jacobs Engineering Group, now operating as Jacobs Solutions, is one of the world's largest providers of professional, technical, and construction services, offering full-spectrum support to industries including aerospace, energy, environmental, infrastructure, and transportation. This entry is retained for legacy continuity; current activity is tracked under Jacobs Solutions.

providers.name: Liberty Interactive
providers.description: Liberty Interactive Corporation owned and operated a broad range of video and online commerce companies, including QVC, HSN, and zulily, before being reorganized into Qurate Retail Group in 2018. The corporation tracked separate operating units through Liberty Interactive Group and Liberty Ventures Group tracking stocks.

providers.name: LKQ
providers.description: LKQ Corporation is a Fortune 500 company and a leading provider of alternative and specialty parts to repair and accessorize automobiles and other vehicles, with operations across North America, Europe, and Taiwan. LKQ does not currently expose a public developer portal or REST API; this repository captures publicly available company and partner-program references.

providers.name: Nucor
providers.description: Nucor Corporation is a Fortune 500 American steel and steel products manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of any material in North America. Nucor does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this index captures the corporate, sustainability, and certification resources that are publicly available.

providers.name: PerkinElmer
providers.description: PerkinElmer is a global leader in scientific instrumentation, lab services, and informatics for life sciences, diagnostics, food, environmental, and industrial markets. The company provides analytical instruments, reagents, software, and software downloads to support laboratory operations and scientific research.

providers.name: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings
providers.description: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings is one of the world's largest manufacturers of aerostructures for commercial airplanes, defense platforms, and business and regional jets. Spirit designs and builds fuselages, pylons, nacelles, and wing components for major aircraft programs including Boeing 737 MAX, 787, and Airbus A350. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs; its digital operations are focused on internal supply chain, manufacturing execution, and enterprise systems.

providers.name: Allergan
providers.description: Allergan was a global pharmaceutical company that developed, manufactured, and commercialized branded therapeutics, devices, and biologic products across medical aesthetics, eye care, central nervous system, and gastroenterology. The company was the maker of Botox (botulinum toxin), Juvederm (injectable filler), CoolSculpting, Alphagan, Vraylar, Linzess, and Ubrelvy. AbbVie completed its $63 billion acquisition of Allergan in May 2020. The company now operates as Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company. Allergan Data Labs, the digital innovation arm, built the Alle loyalty platform serving over 3 million users across nearly 20,000 medical offices and spas in the US, using machine learning for personalized consumer engagement in medical aesthetics. Allergan Aesthetics does not maintain a public developer API program.

providers.name: Avon Products
providers.description: Avon Products is a global manufacturer and marketer of beauty and related products, primarily distributed through a network of independent sales representatives. Founded in 1886 and headquartered in Northampton, UK as Avon International, it was owned by Natura &Co from 2020 until Regent acquired it in January 2026; its corporate site is avonworldwide.com. The North American business (avon.com) was separated in 2016 and has been run as a distinct company.

providers.name: Bright Horizons Family Solutions
providers.description: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. (NYSE: BFAM) is the largest provider of employer-sponsored child care in the United States, headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts and founded in 1986 by Linda Mason and Roger Brown. The company operates more than 1,000 early-education and child-care centers across the US, UK, Netherlands, and India, serving roughly 1,450 employer clients through three core lines: Full Service Center-Based Child Care (on-site and near-site centers for employer-sponsored families), Back-Up Care (last-minute child, adult/elder, and pet care via in-home and in-center networks), and Educational Advisory Services. The Educational Advisory segment is anchored by EdAssist by Bright Horizons (tuition assistance, student loan repayment, and workforce education administration covering 257 employer clients, 4.7 million eligible learners, and more than $1 billion in education and loan payments administered annually), College Coach (college admissions coaching delivered as an employee benefit), and Sittercity (consumer caregiver marketplace acquired in 2020 and offered through corporate benefits). Bright Horizons sells exclusively to enterprise HR and benefits buyers — 72 of the Fortune 1000's top 100 companies use EdAssist — and does not publish public APIs, SDKs, a developer portal, status page, or a public GitHub organization. The brighthorizons GitHub org exists but contains zero public repositories. This profile documents the corporate structure, segment portfolio, and employer-benefit positioning of a child-care and family-benefits operator that runs a closed B2B technology stack with no third-party developer surface.

providers.name: Caesars Entertainment
providers.description: Caesars Entertainment is the largest U.S. casino-entertainment company, operating over 50 gaming facilities, hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues across the country and internationally. The company operates the Caesars Rewards loyalty program and offers gaming, hospitality, dining, entertainment, meetings and conventions, and retail experiences.

providers.name: Colony Capital (DigitalBridge Group)
providers.description: Colony Capital was a diversified real estate and hospitality investment firm founded by Tom Barrack in 1991. In June 2021 the company rebranded as DigitalBridge Group, Inc. (NYSE: DBRG) — completing a multi-year pivot from traditional real estate to pure-play digital infrastructure investing. The Boca Raton, FL-based alternative asset manager now operates exclusively across five digital infrastructure categories: data centers, macro cell towers, fiber networks, small cells, and edge infrastructure. DigitalBridge manages approximately $119B in assets across 45+ portfolio companies including Vantage Data Centers, DataBank, Switch, Vertical Bridge, Zayo Group, GD Towers, Boingo Wireless, AtlasEdge, Scala Data Centers, Yondr Group, and ExteNet Systems. In December 2025 SoftBank Group announced a definitive agreement to acquire DigitalBridge for approximately $4 billion, with the deal expected to close in the second half of 2026. DigitalBridge itself publishes no developer API, SDK, or public OpenAPI surface — it is a holding company whose programmable surface lives inside its individual portfolio companies (e.g., Zayo, DataBank, Switch), each of which is profiled separately in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Consolidated Edison
providers.description: Consolidated Edison, Inc. (NYSE: ED) is a Fortune 500 utility holding company headquartered in New York City. It publishes no APIs of its own; it operates through its regulated subsidiaries, principally Consolidated Edison Company of New York (CECONY), which serves electric, gas and steam customers in New York City and Westchester County, and Orange and Rockland Utilities (O&R), along with Con Edison Transmission. The developer surface - Green Button Connect My Data (Share My Data) and Green Button Download My Data, both served from coned.com - belongs to CECONY and is profiled under the con-edison provider. This profile covers the holding company only.

providers.name: Corteva
providers.description: Corteva Agriscience is a publicly traded, Fortune 500 global pure-play agriculture company that provides farmers around the world with one of the most complete portfolios in the industry, including a balanced and diverse mix of seed, crop protection, and digital products. Corteva was formed as the spinoff of the agriculture division of DowDuPont in June 2019. The company markets seeds under the Pioneer, Brevant, and other brands and crop protection products including herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, and biologicals. Corteva also operates Granular, a farm management software platform with insights and analytics products. A public developer API is not currently published; growers access tools through the Granular Insights and Granular Link platforms.

providers.name: FM (FM Global)
providers.description: FM (formerly FM Global) is a mutual insurance company specializing in commercial and industrial property insurance, loss prevention engineering, and risk management research. FM operates through six business units including FM, FM Affiliated, FM Approvals, FM Boiler Re, FM Cargo, and FM Renewable Energy, and is one of the largest commercial property insurers in the world. This repository tracks the FM (fm.com) entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. The abbreviation "FM" is also used in unrelated contexts (Facilities Management, FM radio broadcasting, financial management); this repository is scoped to the FM Global commercial property insurer that owns the fm.com domain. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: FMC Technologies (now TechnipFMC)
providers.description: FMC Technologies was a Houston-based energy services and equipment company serving the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly subsea, surface, and measurement solutions for hydrocarbon production. In January 2017 FMC Technologies completed its merger with Technip to form TechnipFMC, a global energy services company serving the subsea, surface, and offshore project markets. This repository tracks the legacy FMC Technologies brand and any successor APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with the merged TechnipFMC entity. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: Hasbro
providers.description: Hasbro is a global play and entertainment company committed to making the world a better place for children and their families through brands and franchises including NERF, MAGIC: THE GATHERING, MY LITTLE PONY, and TRANSFORMERS. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Hasbro. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.

providers.name: Hexion
providers.description: Hexion is a global leader in thermosetting resins, providing a broad range of adhesive, structural, and specialty resins to a wide variety of industries including coatings, construction, electronics, and automotive. Their purpose is to activate science to change our world.

providers.name: Hormel Foods
providers.description: Hormel Foods Corporation is a global branded food company with over $12 billion in annual revenue. Known for brands like SPAM, Skippy, Jennie-O, Hormel, and Planters. The company produces and markets a wide range of meat, nut, and food products. No public APIs were identified.

providers.name: Huntsman
providers.description: Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global chemical manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals serving a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets, with operating segments in polyurethanes, performance products, and advanced materials. Huntsman maintains a Technology Portal for partner collaborations, but no public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: International Flavors & Fragrances
providers.description: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) is a global creator of flavors, fragrances, and ingredients for consumer products including perfumes, cosmetics, food, beverages, and household goods. IFF is a Fortune 500 company with no documented public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Iron Mountain
providers.description: Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services, providing records management, data centers, secure shredding, digital transformation, and asset lifecycle management for organizations worldwide. Iron Mountain helps customers protect and unlock value from their physical and digital information assets.

providers.name: KAR Auction Services (Historical)
providers.description: KAR Auction Services was a leading provider of vehicle auction, vehicle remarketing, and salvage auction services in North America. The company divested its salvage business IAA in 2023 (now part of RB Global) and rebranded its remaining wholesale business as OPENLANE. This repository is retained for historical reference. For current activity see the OPENLANE repository.

providers.name: Kennametal
providers.description: Kennametal is a leading provider of productivity solutions for metalworking, earth cutting, and wear components, coatings, and powders. Kennametal offers online integration services including Punch-Out / OCI (Open Catalog Interface), EDI, and a Product Data Portal for catalog and product information.

providers.name: Lear
providers.description: Lear Corporation is a Fortune 500 global automotive technology leader in Seating and E-Systems, delivering complete seat systems, electrical distribution and connection systems, and intelligent in-vehicle technology to vehicles from major automakers worldwide. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Legg Mason
providers.description: Legg Mason was a global asset management firm offering investment products and services through a network of investment affiliates before being acquired by Franklin Resources (Franklin Templeton) in 2020. Investor resources and product information are now consolidated under Franklin Templeton, and no public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Manitowoc
providers.description: Manitowoc Cranes is one of the world's largest providers of lifting equipment for the global construction industry, including lattice-boom crawler cranes, tower cranes, mobile hydraulic cranes, and boom trucks. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: Marathon Oil
providers.description: Marathon Oil was an independent international energy company that engaged in the exploration, production, and marketing of liquid hydrocarbons and natural gas. The company was acquired by ConocoPhillips in 2024, and its public web presence now redirects to ConocoPhillips. No public developer APIs have been identified.

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Public Storage
providers.description: Public Storage is an American real estate investment trust (REIT) that acquires, develops, owns, and operates self-storage facilities throughout the United States and Europe. Headquartered in Glendale, California, it is one of the largest self-storage operators in the world, serving customers via its online reservation system (eRental), mobile apps, and physical facilities. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: PVH
providers.description: PVH Corp, formerly known as the Phillips-Van Heusen Corporation, is an American clothing company headquartered in Manhattan, New York City and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker PVH. Founded in 1881, PVH today operates two iconic owned global brands — Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger — along with licensed brands including Kenneth Cole New York and Michael Kors. PVH divested its Heritage Brands wholesale business (Van Heusen, Arrow, Izod, Geoffrey Beene) to Authentic Brands Group in August 2021, refocusing the company on its two flagship designer lifestyle brands. PVH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the corporate level; technology and commerce integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed wholesale, licensing, and retail technology partnerships.

providers.name: ServiceMaster Global Holdings
providers.description: ServiceMaster Global Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SERV) was the Memphis-based parent company behind Terminix, ServiceMaster Restore, ServiceMaster Clean, Merry Maids, AmeriSpec and Furniture Medic — termite and pest control, disaster restoration, commercial and residential cleaning, home inspection and furniture repair, delivered largely through a franchise network. The company no longer exists under this name. On 1 October 2020 it sold the ServiceMaster Brands franchise business to Roark Capital for $1.553 billion, and later that month renamed itself Terminix Global Holdings, Inc., changing its NYSE ticker to TMX. Rentokil Initial plc completed its acquisition of Terminix Global Holdings in October 2022, absorbing the remaining pest-control business. The ServiceMaster brand itself continues under the independent, Roark-owned ServiceMaster Brands at servicemaster.com. Neither the historic holding company nor its successors publish a public developer program, API documentation, or a machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Toll Brothers
providers.description: Toll Brothers is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, designing, building, marketing, and arranging financing for luxury residential communities across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company and #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list, Toll Brothers operates across 60+ markets. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs. Website integrations and home search functionality are provided through the tollbrothers.com consumer platform.

providers.name: Alleghany
providers.description: Alleghany Corporation is a holding company engaged in property and casualty reinsurance and insurance through its subsidiaries, with additional investments in non-financial businesses held via Alleghany Capital. Founded in 1929 by railroad entrepreneurs Oris and Mantis Van Sweringen, the company transitioned over decades from rail holdings into specialty insurance and reinsurance, and is headquartered at One Rockefeller Plaza in New York City. Its principal insurance subsidiaries are Transatlantic Reinsurance Company (TransRe), a global reinsurer founded in 1977 with roughly 600 employees across 23 offices and more than $40 billion in claims paid to date; RSUI Group, a wholesale excess and surplus (E&S) underwriter spanning Property, Casualty, Professional Liability, Management Liability, and Binding Authority lines; and CapSpecialty, a specialty casualty and surety underwriter. Alleghany Capital holds non-insurance operating companies including toy and collectibles maker Jazwares (Squishmallows, Pokémon, Roblox, Fortnite licensed lines). On March 21, 2022, Berkshire Hathaway announced an $11.6 billion all-cash acquisition of Alleghany at $848.02 per share, which closed in October 2022. Alleghany now operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, contributing approximately $8.8 billion in 2025 gross premiums written and roughly $14 billion in insurance float to the parent. As a holding company whose operating units distribute exclusively through reinsurance intermediaries, wholesale brokers, and independent agents, Alleghany and its subsidiaries do not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or any other machine-readable API artifacts; the only digital surfaces exposed publicly are gated broker and agent login portals.

providers.name: Church and Dwight
providers.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is a Fortune 500 American consumer packaged goods (CPG) company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, that manufactures and markets a portfolio of household, personal care, health and wellness, beauty, and specialty products. Best known as the parent company of the Arm & Hammer baking soda brand (the company's flagship since 1846), Church & Dwight operates through three reporting segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division. The company's brand portfolio includes Arm & Hammer, Trojan, OxiClean, Vitafusion, L'il Critters, Therabreath, Hero (Mighty Patch), Batiste, Waterpik, OraJel, Nair, Spinbrush, First Response, RepHresh, Zicam, Flawless, Toppik, Viviscal, Kaboom, Orange Glo, XTRA laundry detergent, and Arrid antiperspirant. Church & Dwight does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are managed through internal portals, and consumer experiences focus on brand websites, e-commerce direct-to-consumer storefronts, and the Innovation Portal for external R&D partnerships.

providers.name: Danaher
providers.description: Danaher Corporation is a global life sciences and diagnostics conglomerate whose operating companies include Beckman Coulter, Leica Microsystems, Cepheid, SCIEX, IDT, Cytiva, Abcam, Aldevron, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, Radiometer, and others. Danaher itself does not publish a corporate-level developer API; product and service APIs are provided by individual operating companies under the Danaher portfolio.

providers.name: General Mills
providers.description: General Mills is a leading global food company that manufactures and markets branded consumer foods including Cheerios, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Haagen- Dazs, Nature Valley, Old El Paso, and Progresso. General Mills operates in over 100 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API portal and primarily relies on EDI and direct supply chain integrations with retail partners.

providers.name: Harman International
providers.description: Harman International, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics, is a global leader in connected technologies for automotive, consumer, and enterprise markets, including connected car systems, audio products, professional solutions, and connected services. Harman does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; integrations with Harman platforms (such as Ignite, Ready Connect, and audio brands like JBL, Harman Kardon, and AKG) are typically delivered through commercial partnerships and OEM agreements.

providers.name: KBR
providers.description: KBR is a Fortune 500 company that delivers science, technology, and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world, spanning defense, intelligence, space, energy transition, and sustainable infrastructure markets.

providers.name: Lululemon Athletica
providers.description: Lululemon Athletica is a designer, distributor, and retailer of technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories for women, men, and girls. Lululemon does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; digital integrations are handled through partner relationships and internal ecommerce, retail, and supply-chain platforms.

providers.name: McGraw Hill Financial
providers.description: McGraw Hill Financial was a financial information and analytics company providing credit ratings, benchmarks, and analytics to global capital and commodity markets. The company was renamed S&P Global in 2016. No public developer APIs are currently documented under the McGraw Hill Financial brand.

providers.name: MGM Resorts International
providers.description: MGM Resorts International is a global entertainment company with national and international locations featuring best-in-class hotels and casinos, state-of-the-art meetings and conference spaces, and dining and entertainment venues. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for MGM Resorts International.

providers.name: Monsanto
providers.description: Monsanto was a global agricultural products company that produced seeds, biotechnology trait products, and herbicides before being acquired by Bayer AG in 2018. Operations and brands have since been integrated into the Bayer Crop Science division.

providers.name: Nortek
providers.description: Nortek is a global manufacturer of HVAC, data center cooling, and cleanroom systems, organized into three divisions: Nortek Air Solutions, Nortek Data Center Cooling, and Nortek Cleanroom Solutions. No public developer portal or OpenAPI specifications have been identified at this time; this repository tracks Nortek for future API discovery and integration intelligence.

providers.name: Publix Super Markets
providers.description: Publix Super Markets is one of the largest employee-owned supermarket chains in the United States, headquartered in Lakeland, Florida. It operates grocery stores, pharmacies, delivery, catering, and online ordering services across the southeastern United States. Publix is a Fortune 500 company. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Williams-Sonoma
providers.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American publicly traded retail company specializing in kitchenware and home furnishings. It is one of the largest e-commerce retailers in the United States. The company operates multiple brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, PBteen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark and Graham, and Green Row. Williams-Sonoma does not offer a public developer API. The company uses internal APIs and third-party platforms for e-commerce, registry services, and supply chain management.

providers.name: Cabot Oil & Gas
providers.description: Cabot Oil & Gas was an independent oil and gas company engaged in the development, exploitation, exploration, production, and marketing of natural gas and oil properties in the United States. In 2021 it merged with Cimarex Energy to form Coterra Energy, which operates across the Permian Basin, Marcellus Shale, and Anadarko Basin.

providers.name: Chevron
providers.description: Chevron Corporation is one of the world's largest integrated energy companies, with operations across upstream exploration and production, downstream refining and marketing, and the production and transportation of crude oil, natural gas, refined fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and renewable fuels. Chevron is headquartered in Houston, Texas, and operates globally under brands including Chevron, Texaco, and Caltex. Chevron does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; supplier and partner integrations are handled through the Chevron Invoice and Payment Status (CIPS) system and the Supplier Relations channels, and investors and stakeholders are served through corporate, sustainability, and IR websites.

providers.name: Curtiss-Wright
providers.description: Curtiss-Wright is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions, and services mainly to the aerospace, defense, commercial power, process, and general industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans rugged embedded computing, mission-critical avionics, electronic packaging, naval propulsion, reactor coolant pumps for nuclear power, surface treatment services, industrial valves, sensors, data acquisition systems, telemetry ground stations, emergency arresting systems for military aircraft, and electronic systems for naval shipbuilding programs. The company traces its lineage to the aviation pioneers Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers and today operates across the Defense Electronics, Naval & Power, and Aerospace & Industrial segments.

providers.name: Diplomat Pharmacy
providers.description: Diplomat Pharmacy was an independent provider of specialty pharmacy services that helped patients with chronic and complex conditions access and manage specialty medications. The company was acquired by UnitedHealth Group's OptumRx, and operations have been integrated under that brand. No publicly documented developer APIs are offered under the Diplomat Pharmacy name.

providers.name: Graham Holdings
providers.description: Graham Holdings (NYSE: GHC) is a diversified holding company with operations in education, television broadcasting, digital media, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive, restaurants, and custom framing. Principal subsidiaries include Kaplan (educational services), Graham Media Group and Social News Desk (broadcasting and social media tools), The Slate Group and Foreign Policy (digital publishing), Code3 and City Cast (digital marketing and local news), Hoover Treated Wood Products, Joyce/Dayton, Group Dekko, and Forney (manufacturing), Graham Healthcare Group (home health and hospice), Graham Automotive (dealerships), Clyde's Restaurant Group (including Old Ebbitt Grill), and Framebridge (online custom framing). No public developer APIs have been identified across the portfolio.

providers.name: Hess
providers.description: Hess Corporation was an independent global energy company engaged in the exploration, development, production, transportation, purchase, and sale of crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas. Its core operations centered on onshore unconventional production in the Bakken Shale of North Dakota and a major offshore position in the Stabroek Block in Guyana, with additional interests in the Gulf of Mexico, Canada, and Southeast Asia. Chevron Corporation completed its $53 billion all-stock acquisition of Hess on July 18, 2025, after a regulatory and arbitration delay that included a Federal Trade Commission consent order barring former CEO John B. Hess from serving on Chevron's board and a parallel ExxonMobil/CNOOC arbitration over Guyana right-of-first-refusal claims. Hess is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chevron, and the ONE GUYANA FPSO at Stabroek has come online to produce approximately 250,000 barrels of oil per day. Hess Corporation has never offered public developer APIs; its technology integrations were handled through enterprise partner systems and joint-venture operator portals.

providers.name: Intuitive Surgical
providers.description: Intuitive Surgical is the global leader in robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery, developing and marketing the da Vinci surgical system, Ion endoluminal system, and the Intuitive Hub for case management, streaming, and integration in operating rooms worldwide.

providers.name: Kenvue
providers.description: Kenvue is the world's largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, formed from the consumer health spin-off of Johnson & Johnson. Everyday care is a powerful catalyst in making you feel better, inside and out. Kenvue's iconic brands include Tylenol, Neutrogena, Listerine, Aveeno, Band-Aid, and Johnson's.

providers.name: NextEra Energy
providers.description: NextEra Energy, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American energy company and one of the largest electric utility holding companies in the United States. It is the world's largest generator of renewable energy from the wind and sun, and a world leader in battery storage. NextEra Energy operates principally through its two subsidiaries, Florida Power & Light (FPL) and NextEra Energy Resources. This repository captures the public-facing digital surface, corporate touchpoints, and any developer or data resources for NextEra Energy. No public REST APIs, developer portal, or machine-readable data feeds have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Par Pacific Holdings
providers.description: Par Pacific Holdings is an entrepreneurial liquid fuels company focused on owning and operating energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically- complex markets. The company operates refining, retail, and logistics businesses across Hawaii, Washington, Wyoming, and Montana, with retail brands including 76, Hele, and nomnom.

providers.name: ProPetro Holding
providers.description: ProPetro Holding Corp (NYSE: PUMP) is a Midland, Texas-based oilfield services company that "provides hydraulic fracturing and other complementary services to leading upstream oil and gas companies engaged in the exploration and production of North American unconventional oil and natural gas resources," operating principally in the Permian Basin. Service lines include hydraulic fracturing, the FORCE electric fleet (eFleet), Silvertip Wireline, cementing, PROPWR power solutions, and Aqua Prop water management. ProPetro does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or technology developer portal.

providers.name: Quanta Services
providers.description: Quanta Services is a Fortune 500 specialty contracting company that delivers infrastructure solutions to the electric power, renewable energy, oil and gas, pipeline, and communications industries throughout North America and Australia.

providers.name: Chesapeake Energy
providers.description: Chesapeake Energy Corporation was an independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, focused on unconventional natural gas and oil fields onshore in the United States. In October 2024, Chesapeake combined with Southwestern Energy to form Expand Energy Corporation, which now operates as the largest natural gas producer in the United States. Chesapeake Energy does not currently expose a public developer API; royalty owners and partners interact through the Owner Online Accounts portal, and investors are served via the Expand Energy investor relations site.

providers.name: Dominion Resources
providers.description: Dominion Resources is the former name of Dominion Energy, one of the nation's largest producers and transporters of energy, providing electricity and natural gas to customers across multiple U.S. states. The company rebranded from Dominion Resources to Dominion Energy in 2017. No public developer APIs are currently published.

providers.name: Eli Lilly
providers.description: Eli Lilly and Company is a Fortune 500 global pharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and sells human pharmaceutical products in therapeutic areas including diabetes, oncology, immunology, and neuroscience. Eli Lilly does not currently publish a public developer API portal; the company exposes selected machine learning models through its Lilly TuneLab platform to partner biotechs but does not offer general purpose, self-serve APIs.

providers.name: Harris Computer
providers.description: Harris Computer is a constellation of companies acquiring and operating vertical market software businesses across the public sector, healthcare, utilities, financial services, education, and insurance markets. Harris Computer itself does not publish a unified public developer portal; APIs and integrations are delivered through its individual portfolio companies (such as Harris Local Government, Harris Utilities, Harris Healthcare, and Harris School Solutions). Harris Computer is a subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc.

providers.name: Hartford Financial Services Group
providers.description: The Hartford Financial Services Group is a leading provider of property and casualty insurance, group benefits, and mutual funds and ETFs in the United States. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with The Hartford. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.

providers.name: HF Sinclair
providers.description: HF Sinclair is an independent energy company that produces and markets gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, specialty lubricant products, and renewable diesel fuel through refineries and a brand network of branded fuel stations.

providers.name: HollyFrontier
providers.description: HollyFrontier Corporation (NYSE: HFC) was an independent petroleum refiner and marketer headquartered in Dallas, Texas, formed by the 2011 merger of Holly Corporation and Frontier Oil. It operated refineries across the mid-continent, southwest and Rocky Mountain regions, producing and marketing gasoline, diesel fuel, jet fuel, asphalt and specialty lubricant products, and held the general partner interest in Holly Energy Partners. In 2022 HollyFrontier completed its transactions with The Sinclair Companies and was reorganized under a new parent, HF Sinclair Corporation (NYSE: DINO); the HollyFrontier brand no longer operates independently and www.hollyfrontier.com now redirects to www.hfsinclair.com.

providers.name: Hubbell
providers.description: Hubbell is a global manufacturer of high-quality electrical and electronic products for non-residential and residential construction, industrial, and utility applications. The company has provided trusted infrastructure solutions since 1888 across power and utilities, lighting and controls, wiring and electrical, and datacom product categories serving commercial, data center, industrial, healthcare, telecom, and water and gas markets.

providers.name: Icahn Enterprises
providers.description: Icahn Enterprises L.P. is a diversified holding company engaged in the investment, energy, automotive, food packaging, real estate, home fashion, and pharmaceutical industries through its operating subsidiaries. The company does not currently publish public developer APIs; investor relations, SEC filings, and corporate communications are provided through its corporate website.

providers.name: Kemper
providers.description: The Kemper family of companies is one of the nation's leading insurers. With approximately $13 billion in assets, Kemper is improving the world of insurance by offering personalized solutions for individuals, families and businesses.

providers.name: Marathon Petroleum
providers.description: Marathon Petroleum is one of the largest petroleum product refiners, transporters, and marketers in the United States, with operations including refineries, pipelines, terminals, and retail outlets. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Merck
providers.description: At Merck, we're following the science to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. Get a glimpse of how we work to improve lives. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified for Merck.

providers.name: Monster Beverage
providers.description: Monster Beverage Corporation is a marketer and distributor of energy drinks and alternative beverages, offering brands including Monster Energy, Reign, NOS, Burn, Mother, Relentless, and Predator. It is a Fortune 500 company headquartered in Corona, California.

providers.name: Nationwide
providers.description: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company is a Fortune 100 American mutual insurance and financial services company providing auto, home, life, business, and retirement products. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts for Nationwide.

providers.name: New York Life
providers.description: New York Life Insurance Company is the largest mutual life insurance company in the United States, headquartered in Manhattan, New York. The company provides life insurance, fixed and variable annuities, long-term care, and investment management (through subsidiaries such as New York Life Investments / NYLIM). New York Life has maintained the highest financial-strength ratings from major rating agencies for more than a century. No public developer portal or external APIs have been identified; agent, partner, and reinsurer integrations occur through private B2B channels.

providers.name: Old Republic International
providers.description: Old Republic International is one of the nation's largest publicly held insurance organizations, providing general insurance, title insurance, and life and accident insurance through its subsidiaries. No public developer APIs have been documented at the parent company level at this time.

providers.name: Parexel International
providers.description: Parexel International is one of the largest global biopharmaceutical services companies in the world, providing services that help clients accelerate the discovery and development of new therapies. No public developer API has been documented at this time.

providers.name: PBF Energy
providers.description: PBF Energy is one of the largest independent petroleum refiners and suppliers of unbranded transportation fuels, heating oils, lubricants, petrochemical feedstocks, and other petroleum products in the United States, operating refineries and a logistics network across the country.

providers.name: PPL
providers.description: PPL Corporation is a U.S. energy company that delivers electricity and natural gas to customers through its regulated utilities in Pennsylvania, Kentucky, and Rhode Island. PPL is a Fortune 500 company.

providers.name: Praxair
providers.description: Praxair was an American multinational industrial gases company that merged with Linde AG in 2018 to form Linde plc. Praxair operations in the United States now operate as Linde. The company supplies atmospheric, process, and specialty gases, along with related equipment and services to a range of industries.

providers.name: Public Service Enterprise Group
providers.description: Public Service Enterprise Group (PSEG) is a publicly traded diversified energy holding company headquartered in Newark, New Jersey. Through its subsidiaries including PSE&G and PSEG Power, the company provides regulated electric and natural gas distribution and operates electric power generation across the northeastern United States. PSEG is a Fortune 500 company. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: SemGroup
providers.description: SemGroup Corporation was a Tulsa, Oklahoma midstream energy service provider that gathered, transported, stored, processed, and marketed crude oil, refined products, and natural gas liquids across North America, and operated the Houston Fuel Oil Terminal (HFOTCO) on the Houston Ship Channel. Energy Transfer LP acquired SemGroup in a $5.1 billion transaction that closed on December 5, 2019; the company was absorbed into Energy Transfer, its NYSE listing retired, and www.semgroup.com now redirects to energytransfer.com. SemGroup never operated a public developer program or API.

providers.name: Spectra Energy
providers.description: Spectra Energy was a Fortune 500 American energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas, focused on natural gas transmission and storage, distribution, and gathering and processing. Founded in 2007 as a spin-off from Duke Energy, Spectra Energy operated the Texas Eastern Pipeline and other major North American natural gas infrastructure. In February 2017, Spectra Energy was acquired by Enbridge Inc. in an all-stock deal valued at approximately $28 billion and no longer operates as an independent entity.

providers.name: Bullpen Strategy Group
providers.description: Bullpen Strategy Group (BSG) is a strategic advisory firm that helps clients solve problems, grow, and manage risk. It provides critical insights and solutions including strategic counsel, communications, research, analysis, media intelligence, and AI‑powered technology. Its clients include Fortune 500 companies, leading law firms, industry associations, and national coalitions, supported by a team of over 50 professionals.

providers.name: Chemtura
providers.description: Chemtura Corporation was a global specialty chemicals company that developed, manufactured, and marketed chemical intermediates, additives, specialty chemicals, urethanes, organometallics, and modern plastics. In April 2017, Chemtura was acquired by LANXESS AG, the German specialty chemicals company headquartered in Cologne, and its operations were integrated into LANXESS's Performance Materials and other business segments. Chemtura products are now marketed and supported through LANXESS, which continues to serve agriculture, animal care, mobility, consumer goods, electrical and electronics, energy, food, and healthcare end markets.

providers.name: Chico's FAS
providers.description: Chico's FAS, Inc. is an American women's specialty retailer headquartered in Fort Myers, Florida, operating and franchising stores and websites under the Chico's, White House Black Market, and Soma brands. The company is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of private branded sophisticated, casual-to-dressy clothing, intimates, sleepwear, and related accessories, with more than 1,400 retail and outlet stores in the United States and a substantial e-commerce footprint. Chico's FAS is part of the KnitWell Group portfolio. Chico's FAS does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are coordinated through corporate channels and the loyalty/credit card partnership with Synchrony and Mastercard.

providers.name: Ecolab
providers.description: Ecolab is a Fortune 500 global leader in water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions and services. The company helps customers in food, healthcare, hospitality, industrial, and energy markets keep their environments clean, safe, and healthy while protecting people and vital resources.

providers.name: Envista Holdings
providers.description: Envista Holdings is a global family of dental products companies and a Fortune 1000 firm whose brands include Nobel Biocare, Ormco, KaVo, and Implant Direct. The company manufactures and supplies dental implants, orthodontic systems, imaging equipment, and consumables to clinicians worldwide. Envista does not publish a public, unified developer portal or external API; integrations are generally handled at the individual brand level for clinical software and imaging workflows.

providers.name: Hawaiian Holdings

providers.description: American Financial is a financial-services profile in the API Evangelist catalog for which no operating company could be resolved on 2026-09-02. The only host ever recorded for it, american-financial.com, is not run by a business: it is a CNAME to traff-https.hugedomains.com and redirects to a HugeDomains "this domain is for sale" listing, so there is no website, no developer program, no documentation and no machine-readable API artifact behind this name. The Fortune 500 insurance and annuities holding company American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG, Great American Insurance Group) is a different company and is profiled separately in this catalog as american-financial-group, where its Great American Carrier Services APIs belong.

providers.name: Crane
providers.description: Crane Co. (NYSE: CR) and its sister company Crane NXT (NYSE: CXT) are industrial manufacturing companies that resulted from the 2023 split of the legacy Crane Holdings, Co. Crane Co. is a diversified manufacturer of highly engineered industrial products serving aerospace and electronics, process flow technologies, and engineered materials markets. Crane NXT is a global leader in trusted technology solutions for payment, security, and authentication including currency, banknote, and authentication products. No public APIs or developer portals are published; integrations with industrial customers are arranged through enterprise channels.

providers.name: Crown Castle
providers.description: Crown Castle is a leading United States provider of shared communications infrastructure including cell towers, small cells, and fiber. Crown Castle owns and operates more than 40,000 cell towers and approximately 90,000 route miles of fiber, supporting wireless carriers, enterprises, and government customers with managed connectivity, dark fiber, optical encryption, ultra-low-latency transport, and managed SD-WAN services. Crown Castle does not currently publish a public developer API program; technical integrations are handled through customer and channel partner agreements.

providers.name: Darden Restaurants
providers.description: Darden Restaurants is the largest full-service restaurant company in the world, owning and operating brands such as Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Yard House, The Capital Grille, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, Eddie V's, Seasons 52, Bahama Breeze, Ruth's Chris Steak House, and Chuy's. Darden does not publish a public developer API; consumer-facing ordering and loyalty are exposed only via internal mobile apps and partnerships such as Uber for delivery.

providers.name: Dover
providers.description: Dover Corporation is a diversified American industrial conglomerate headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois. Dover operates across five segments - Engineered Products, Clean Energy and Fueling, Imaging and Identification, Pumps and Process Solutions, and Climate and Sustainability Technologies - through a portfolio of decentralized operating companies including Dover Fueling Solutions, OPW, Markem-Imaje, PSG, and Vehicle Service Group.

providers.name: Flowers Foods
providers.description: Flowers Foods is one of the largest producers and marketers of packaged bakery foods in the United States, with brands including Nature's Own, Wonder, Dave's Killer Bread, Tastykake, and Mrs. Freshley's. No public, developer-facing APIs have been identified for this company; partner and retailer integrations appear to be handled through internal EDI and account-managed channels.

providers.name: General Growth Properties
providers.description: General Growth Properties (GGP) was a major U.S.-based commercial real estate company and the second-largest shopping mall operator in the United States before being acquired by Brookfield Property Partners in 2018. The GGP portfolio is now operated under Brookfield Properties. No public developer APIs are documented for the legacy GGP entity.

providers.name: Go Deed
providers.description: Go Deed (legally Deed Inc.) is a workplace-giving and corporate social responsibility platform founded in 2016 that helps enterprises engage employees around volunteering, charitable giving, donation matching, and everyday social-impact actions. With teams in New York, San Francisco, and Berlin, Deed served Fortune 500 and mid-market employers before being acquired into Bonterra, where it now ships as the "Deed" employee-engagement product. The joindeed.com domain 301-redirects to bonterratech.com/product/deed. Deed was surfaced as an Earlybird Venture Capital portfolio company (investment 2021) and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. Enrichment found no independent public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification for the standalone Go Deed / Deed brand.

No public APIs or developer programs have been identified for Hain Celestial Group at this time.

providers.name: Ingles Markets
providers.description: Ingles Markets is a regional supermarket chain in the southeastern United States. The company operates retail grocery stores and provides store locator, weekly ad, and digital coupon experiences through its consumer website. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: L Brands
providers.description: L Brands was a Fortune 500 specialty retail holding company best known for Victoria's Secret, PINK, and Bath & Body Works. In 2021 the company split into two independent publicly traded companies, with Bath & Body Works, Inc. retaining the original NYSE listing and Victoria's Secret & Co. spun off as a standalone retailer. The L Brands brand is no longer in active use; this repository preserves the historical corporate record. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Skillbridge
providers.description: Skillbridge (skillbridge.co) was a New York-based online marketplace for freelance consultants and independent professionals, connecting organizations from Fortune 500 companies to early-stage startups with vetted specialists for short-term engagements. Founded in 2013, it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. Skillbridge was acquired by Toptal in 2016 and folded into what became Toptal Business; the skillbridge.co domain now 301-redirects to toptal.com/finance. The company operates no independent developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or event surface, so there are no technical artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Targa Energy

Targa Energy operates as part of the broader Targa Resources enterprise, which is a Fortune 500 midstream infrastructure company focused on the Permian Basin and other major production areas.
