providers.name: AK Steel Holding
providers.description: AK Steel Holding Corporation was a leading producer of flat-rolled carbon, stainless, and electrical steel products, as well as carbon and stainless tubular products, primarily serving the automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, and electrical power markets. AK Steel was acquired by Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. in March 2020 and now operates as a subsidiary.

providers.name: Berry Plastics Group
providers.description: Berry Plastics Group was a manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials serving customers across consumer and industrial markets. The company was renamed Berry Global Group in 2017 to reflect its global operations and diversified product portfolio beyond plastics. As Berry Global, the company agreed in November 2024 to an all-stock combination with Amcor plc, which completed on 30 April 2025; berryglobal.com now redirects to Amcor's packaging site. It never published a developer program, an API, or a machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: BMC Stock Holdings
providers.description: BMC Stock Holdings, Inc. was one of the largest professional building materials distributors in the United States, serving homebuilders, remodelers, and contractors with lumber, structural components, millwork, doors, windows, and installed services. The company was formed in December 2015 through the merger of Stock Building Supply and Building Materials Holding Corporation (BMHC) and traded on NASDAQ under the ticker BMCH, headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. On January 1, 2021, BMC Stock Holdings completed an all-stock "merger of equals" with Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR), creating the nation's largest supplier of structural building products to the professional homebuilding market. The combined company retained the Builders FirstSource name, BLDR ticker, and Irving, Texas headquarters. The merger had an enterprise value of approximately $2.5 billion and produced a company with more than $11 billion in annual sales, approximately 26,000 employees, and roughly 550 distribution and manufacturing locations across more than 40 U.S. states. BMC Stock Holdings no longer exists as an independent entity. The legacy buildwithbmc.com domain redirects to bldr.com, and BMC product lines and branches have been absorbed into the Builders FirstSource network. This profile is retained as a historical Fortune 1000 record (BMC ranked #677 prior to the merger) and as a redirect to the successor profile at api-evangelist/builders-firstsource. BMC operated as a commodity-and-services distributor and did not publish public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or a developer portal. No API surface is documented for this provider.

providers.name: Cimarex Energy
providers.description: Cimarex Energy was an independent oil and gas exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with operations focused in the Permian Basin and the Mid-Continent. In October 2021 Cimarex Energy combined with Cabot Oil & Gas Corporation to form Coterra Energy (NYSE: CTRA). No public Cimarex-branded developer APIs exist; all current digital channels and any future API offerings are part of Coterra Energy.

providers.name: Computer Sciences Corporation
providers.description: Computer Sciences Corporation (CSC) was a multinational information technology services and professional services company. On April 1, 2017, CSC merged with the Enterprise Services line of business of Hewlett Packard Enterprise to form DXC Technology, retiring the standalone CSC brand. This profile is preserved as a historical record; CSC did not publish any public developer APIs and the entity is no longer actively operated under this name.

providers.name: Concho Resources
providers.description: Concho Resources, Inc. was an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, exploration, and production of oil and natural gas properties primarily in the Permian Basin of West Texas and southeast New Mexico. On January 15, 2021, ConocoPhillips completed an all-stock acquisition of Concho Resources at a total enterprise value of $13.3 billion, retiring the Concho brand. This profile is preserved as a historical record; Concho no longer operates under this name and never published any public developer APIs.

providers.name: Coterra Energy
providers.description: Coterra Energy Inc. (formerly Cabot Oil & Gas, combined with Cimarex Energy in October 2021) was a Houston-headquartered independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company with positions in the Permian Basin, the Marcellus Shale and the Anadarko Basin. On May 7, 2026 Coterra completed an all-stock merger with Devon Energy; the combined company operates as Devon Energy (NYSE: DVN), Coterra's shares were deregistered (Form 15-12G filed 2026-05-19) and investors.coterra.com now redirects to investors.devonenergy.com. The coterra.com site has been reduced to a five-page holding site for interest owners. Coterra never operated a public developer program or API: owner statements are delivered through EnergyLink and production data through PDS Energy, both third-party platforms. The only programmatic access to Coterra data is the SEC's own EDGAR API, listed here as a clearly labeled third-party government API.

providers.name: DCP Midstream
providers.description: DCP Midstream LLC was a Denver, Colorado-based natural gas gathering, processing, and NGL transportation company that operated as one of the largest U.S. producers and marketers of natural gas liquids. In June 2023, Phillips 66 completed the acquisition of all publicly traded common units of DCP Midstream LP for approximately $3.8 billion, taking its ownership stake to 86.8%. DCP Midstream and Phillips 66 Partners were subsequently merged into Phillips 66's NGL and midstream business; the standalone brand, public filings, developer surface, and corporate website have been retired. The dcpmidstream.com domain no longer resolves to a working site, and there is no public DCP-branded developer portal, API reference, status page, or changelog. This repository documents DCP Midstream as a defunct entity absorbed into the Phillips 66 midstream organization.

providers.name: Dean Foods
providers.description: Dean Foods was a leading U.S. food and beverage company and one of the largest processors and direct-to-store distributors of fresh fluid milk and other dairy products. After filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2019, most of Dean Foods' assets were acquired by Dairy Farmers of America (DFA) in 2020. Dean Foods no longer operates as an independent company and does not publish a public developer API; surviving brands are now managed under DFA. This profile is retained for historical reference.

providers.name: EP Energy
providers.description: EP Energy Corporation was an independent exploration and production company engaged in the acquisition and development of unconventional onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States, principally in the Eagle Ford shale and the Uinta basin. The company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in October 2019 and emerged in October 2020. Verdun Oil Company II LLC, an EnCap Investments portfolio company, completed its acquisition of EP Energy on 30 March 2022 for approximately $1.45 billion, with the Utah/Uinta assets divested post-closing under an FTC order. EP Energy is no longer an operating company. It never published an API, SDK, or developer program, and its corporate domain epenergy.com now redirects to the acquirer, verdunoilco.com. The unrelated hyphenated domain ep-energy.com is a GoDaddy aftermarket listing offered for sale and is not an EP Energy surface.

providers.name: Good Technology
providers.description: Good Technology was an enterprise mobile security company whose Good Dynamics platform provided app-level encryption, data loss prevention, secure inter-app communication, and a secure application-development SDK/API used by ISVs, systems integrators, and enterprises to build secured mobile apps across iOS and Android. The company served more than 6,200 organizations, including over half of the Fortune 100. Good Technology was acquired by BlackBerry in October 2015 for approximately $425 million and folded into BlackBerry's enterprise mobility (UEM) portfolio; it no longer operates as an independent entity and its former developer surface (good.com) now redirects to blackberry.com. This profile is retained as a historical company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jarden
providers.description: Jarden Corporation was an American consumer products conglomerate that owned brands across Outdoor Solutions (Coleman, K2 Sports, Marmot, Rawlings), Consumer Solutions (Crock-Pot, Mr. Coffee, Sunbeam, Oster, FoodSaver), Branded Consumables (Yankee Candle, First Alert, Diamond Match), and Process Solutions. Jarden was acquired by Newell Rubbermaid on April 15, 2016, with the combined entity rebranded as Newell Brands. As such, Jarden no longer exists as an independent company and does not maintain its own APIs.

providers.name: Kansas City Southern
providers.description: Kansas City Southern (KCS) was a transportation holding company that operated freight rail networks across the United States and Mexico. On April 14, 2023, KCS merged with Canadian Pacific Railway to form Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC), the first single-line rail network connecting Canada, the United States, and Mexico. CPKC operates approximately 32,000 km (20,000 mi) of rail and is headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, with U.S. headquarters in Kansas City, Missouri.

providers.name: NBTY
providers.description: NBTY was a leading global vertically integrated manufacturer, marketer, distributor, and retailer of vitamins and nutritional supplements before being renamed The Nature's Bounty Co., which was subsequently sold and reorganized. No public APIs exist under the NBTY name.

providers.name: People's United Financial
providers.description: Defunct U.S. regional bank holding company, headquartered in Bridgeport, Connecticut. Acquired by M&T Bank Corporation in an all-stock deal valued at approximately $7.6 billion. The acquisition was announced February 22, 2021 and closed April 2, 2022. People's United operated roughly 403 branches at close and was fully integrated into M&T Bank by Q3 2022. The People's United brand has been retired; peoples.com now 301-redirects to mtb.com. No public developer program, OpenAPI definitions, SDKs, GitHub organization, or documented APIs existed at any point during its operating history.

providers.name: QEP Resources
providers.description: QEP Resources was an independent natural gas and crude oil exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with operations in the United States. The company was acquired by Diamondback Energy in 2021 and no longer operates as an independent entity.

providers.name: Scripps Networks Interactive
providers.description: Scripps Networks Interactive, Inc. (NASDAQ: SNI) was a Knoxville, Tennessee lifestyle media company that owned HGTV, Food Network, Travel Channel, DIY Network, Great American Country and Cooking Channel, plus digital properties including ulive. Discovery Communications completed its $14.6B acquisition on 2018-03-06 and renamed itself Discovery, Inc.; the brands now sit inside Warner Bros. Discovery. Scripps Networks Interactive no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no developer program, API or machine-readable contract. Its former corporate domain, scrippsnetworksinteractive.com, has since been re-registered by an unrelated party and now serves an Australian online-gambling affiliate site, so it must not be linked as a company property.

providers.name: Sears Holdings
providers.description: Sears Holdings was the American holding company behind the Sears and Kmart department store chains. It filed for Chapter 11 in October 2018 and its retail operations were acquired in 2019 by Transform Holdco LLC, which trades as Transformco (Transform SR Brands LLC), the entity that operates Sears.com, Kmart.com and ShopYourWay.com today. The live developer surface carried forward from that estate is the Sears Marketplace Seller API — a versioned XML-over-HTTPS integration for third-party sellers covering catalog and item management, item class and attribute libraries, inventory, pricing, purchase order retrieval, order cancellations, returns and partial or full refunds, ASN and shipment updates, order prep time, installation service items, and remittance, removed-item, content-match and processing reports. Every API is published with a downloadable XSD and a sample XML document, both fetchable without credentials from seller.marketplace.sears.com, and calls are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 authorization header rather than OAuth. There is no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP server or A2A agent card on any Sears, Kmart or Transformco host.

providers.name: TCF Financial Corporation
providers.description: Profile for TCF Financial Corporation, a former Detroit-headquartered regional bank holding company (Twin City Building and Loan Association, founded 1923). TCF was merged into Huntington Bancshares Incorporated on June 9, 2021, and the TCF brand was fully retired. This repository is preserved for historical record only — TCF Financial no longer operates and exposes no APIs. All banking, treasury, deposit, and lending services formerly offered under the TCF brand are now operated by Huntington National Bank under the Huntington brand. See the huntington-bancshares repository for current API surface (which is itself minimal; Huntington exposes no public developer portal).

providers.name: YRC Worldwide
providers.description: YRC Worldwide (rebranded as Yellow Corporation in 2021) was a holding company whose subsidiaries — YRC Freight, Holland, Reddaway, New Penn, and HNRY Logistics — provided less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation, brokerage, and logistics services across North America. The company ceased operations on July 30, 2023 and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on August 6, 2023, ending nearly 100 years of operation. Bankruptcy asset sales redistributed terminals and equipment to Saia, XPO, Estes, and other carriers; no public developer APIs were ever published.

bands.label: Not Yet Rated
bands.blurb: Providers we have not scored yet — unknown, not zero.

providers.name: Anadarko Petroleum
providers.description: Anadarko Petroleum Corporation was one of the world's largest independent oil and natural gas exploration and production companies, with operations across the United States, the deepwater Gulf of Mexico, and international locations including Mozambique and Ghana. Anadarko was acquired by Occidental Petroleum in August 2019 in a $55 billion transaction. The company was known for its operations in the Wattenberg Gas Field in Colorado, the Delaware Basin in Texas, and major deepwater projects. Anadarko did not offer public developer APIs; its technology integrations were primarily through enterprise systems for partners and joint venture operators.

providers.name: Anthem
providers.description: Anthem, operating under Elevance Health, is one of the largest health benefits companies in the United States, serving members through affiliated Blue Cross and Blue Shield health plans in California, New York, Virginia, Georgia, Ohio, Indiana and other states, and through the Amerigroup, Wellpoint, Healthy Blue, Simply HealthCare, Unicare, Summit and Clear Health Alliance brands. Anthem's public API surface exists because the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule (CMS-9115-F) requires it: three HL7 FHIR APIs — Patient Access (five years of medical, dental, vision and pharmacy claims plus clinical data, under CARIN IG for Blue Button STU 2.1.0 and SMART on FHIR), Provider Directory (Da Vinci PDEX Plan Net 1.1.0) and Drug Formulary (Da Vinci PDEX US Drug Formulary 2.0.1 STU2) — served from totalview.healthos.elevancehealth.com, alongside a separate live SMART-on-FHIR member server, Patient360, still running FHIR DSTU2. There is no commercial API product, no pricing, no client SDK and no self-serve key: production credentials are issued by secure email after a human-reviewed request form. Payer-to-Payer, Prior Authorization and Provider Access APIs are committed under CMS-0057-F by 2027-01-01.

providers.name: Apache Software Foundation
providers.description: The Apache Software Foundation (ASF) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that provides open source software for the public good. Home to more than 300 open source projects maintained by a global community of over 9,900 committers and 1,190 members, the ASF operates under the principle of community over code. Projects span big data, cloud infrastructure, messaging, web frameworks, databases, build tooling, machine learning, and more — all released under the Apache License.

providers.name: AT&T
providers.description: AT&T is a multinational telecommunications holding company providing wireless and wireline telecommunications services, broadband, and digital entertainment to consumers and businesses worldwide. AT&T offers a suite of developer APIs spanning messaging, speech, mobile virtual network operations, business voice, wholesale service qualification, enterprise wireline ordering, and mobility management, enabling developers and enterprise partners to integrate AT&T network capabilities into applications and systems.

providers.name: AT&T
providers.description: AT&T Inc. is a multinational telecommunications conglomerate providing wireless and wireline communications, broadband internet, digital TV, and business services. As a Fortune 100 company, AT&T operates one of the largest telecommunications networks in the United States and globally. This profile covers AT&T's full API ecosystem including consumer telecommunications APIs, enterprise connectivity APIs, and business service management APIs available through AT&T's developer programs.

providers.name: ATI
providers.description: Allegheny Technologies Incorporated, which trades and brands itself as ATI Inc., is an American producer of specialty materials and components headquartered in Dallas, Texas and listed on the NYSE under the ticker ATI. ATI melts, forges, rolls, machines and additively manufactures titanium and titanium alloys, nickel-based alloys and superalloys, stainless and specialty steels, zirconium, hafnium, niobium and tungsten materials, plus forgings and castings. It serves aerospace and defense — over half of sales — along with oil and gas, chemical and hydrocarbon processing, power generation, medical and electronics markets, on roughly $4.6 billion in annual revenue. ATI is a materials manufacturer rather than a software company and publishes no public API: as of 2026-09-01 probing found no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL or WSDL contract, no SDK on any public package registry and no GitHub organization. The only credentialed digital surfaces are My ATI, a customer and supplier extranet behind a logon form, and a third-party sourcing platform linked from the supplier self-service page; customer onboarding itself is documented as PDF forms emailed to a sales contact.

providers.name: AuditBoard
providers.description: AuditBoard, now operating as Optro, provides AI‑powered governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software for enterprises. Its platform combines real‑time risk intelligence, autonomous testing, and integrated audit tools to help organizations streamline risk management, compliance, and internal audit processes. With a focus on modern cloud‑based solutions, Optro serves over half of the Fortune 500, offering modules for audit, risk, IT compliance, and continuous monitoring, all powered by AI and analytics.

providers.name: Automatic Data Processing (ADP)
providers.description: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) is a global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions including payroll processing, benefits administration, talent management, time and attendance, workforce analytics, and tax compliance services. ADP serves over 1 million businesses worldwide and provides a comprehensive developer platform with REST APIs, SDKs, and marketplace integrations for HCM system connectivity.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble
providers.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States, operating physical bookstores and an e-commerce site selling books, magazines, gifts, and educational products. Barnes & Noble also operates the Nook e-reader platform and offers affiliate and publisher partner programs. No public developer API is currently offered; the company operates primarily through retail channels and affiliate marketing programs.

providers.name: BrightEdge Technologies
providers.description: BrightEdge is an enterprise SEO and content performance marketing platform, founded in 2007 and headquartered in Foster City, California. Its S3 platform uses AI and machine learning (the BrightEdge "Data Cube" and Copilot/Autopilot engines) to help brands research keywords, optimize content, analyze competitors, audit sites, track SERP features and AI answers, and measure organic search performance against revenue. The BrightEdge Platform API (v5.0) is a REST interface that exposes accounts, keywords, keyword groups, competitors, domains, backlinks, page crawl and cache, Core Web Vitals, market insights, SERP and People-Also-Ask data, AI Catalyst share-of-answer metrics, bulk export jobs, and user administration, letting enterprise customers pull BrightEdge insights into platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Domo, and Marketo. BrightEdge serves 1,700+ brands including dozens of the Fortune 100.

providers.name: Brocade Communications Systems
providers.description: Brocade Communications Systems was a provider of data networking and storage networking products and services, including SAN switches, IP networking equipment, routers, and network management software for enterprises and service providers. Brocade was acquired by Broadcom in 2017. The IP networking business was sold to Extreme Networks, while the Fibre Channel SAN portfolio was retained by Broadcom under the Brocade brand.

providers.name: Calumet
providers.description: Calumet is a specialty hydrocarbon and renewable fuels company that produces a broad portfolio of branded and customer-formulated specialty products including lubricating oils, white mineral oils, solvents, waxes, and renewable diesel through its Montana Renewables subsidiary. The company serves customers across consumer, industrial, and energy markets globally. Calumet does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Campbell Soup
providers.description: The Campbell's Company (formerly Campbell Soup Company) is a Fortune 500 manufacturer and marketer of branded convenience food products — soups, simple meals, beverages, snacks and packaged fresh foods — under Campbell's, Swanson, Pace, Prego, V8, Pepperidge Farm, Goldfish and Snyder's of Hanover. Its public Campbell's Kitchen developer API (developer.campbellskitchen.com) has been retired without announcement; that host returns NXDOMAIN as of 2026-09-05. The recipe and product catalog it served is nevertheless still readable anonymously: the consumer site www.campbells.com exposes a live, unauthenticated WordPress REST API at /wp-json/wp/v2 carrying Campbell's own custom content types (recipe, product, external_product, csc_faq) and product taxonomies, with 316 recipes and 210 products observed. Campbell's does not document, version, price or acknowledge this surface as an API.

providers.name: Carter's
providers.description: Carter's, Inc. is the largest branded marketer of young children's apparel in the United States, operating the Carter's, OshKosh B'gosh, and Skip Hop brands. Its customer-facing digital surface includes carters.com and carters.com/cart e-commerce, mobile apps, a rewards program, and vendor / supply-chain integrations, but no public developer API or partner program is currently published.

providers.name: Centene Corporation
providers.description: A leading managed care company providing health insurance primarily to government-sponsored programs including Medicaid, Medicare, and the Health Insurance Marketplace. Serves over 25 million members across all 50 U.S. states.

providers.name: Cisco Systems
providers.description: Cisco Systems is a global technology company providing networking, security, collaboration, and cloud infrastructure products. Cisco exposes its programmable surface through Cisco DevNet, a single developer portal that aggregates documentation, sandboxes, code exchange, and learning labs across the company's hardware and software portfolio. Major API domains include Catalyst Center and Meraki for network management, IOS XE RESTCONF for device-level programmability, Webex for collaboration, Secure Firewall and ISE for security, ThousandEyes and AppDynamics for observability, and Intersight for cloud-managed infrastructure. Authentication models vary by product line and include OAuth 2.0, API keys, basic-auth token exchange, and HTTP signature authentication.

providers.name: Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings
providers.description: Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings is one of the largest out-of-home advertising companies in the world and a Fortune 1000 firm, operating billboards, street furniture, transit, airport, and digital out-of-home displays across the United States and select international markets. CCO operates the CCO.IO developer platform with the Automated Direct API at direct.cco.io for programmatic-direct buying of inventory, supports programmatic digital-out-of-home (pDOOH) buying through 21+ DSP partners using OpenRTB 2.6 with the DOOH extension, and offers RADAR, an audience and attribution data suite based on aggregated mobile location data. Open-source SDKs for the Automated Direct API are published under the ClearChannelOutdoor GitHub organization.

providers.name: ConAgra Foods
providers.description: ConAgra Foods, Inc. was the prior corporate name of Conagra Brands. In 2015 the company spun off its foodservice ingredients business as Lamb Weston and renamed the remaining packaged-foods business to Conagra Brands, Inc. This profile is preserved as a historical alias; the active company profile lives at the conagra-brands repository. No public developer APIs were ever published under the ConAgra Foods brand.

providers.name: CSX Corporation
providers.description: A leading freight transportation company operating one of the largest rail networks in eastern North America. Moves goods across 23 states and connects to over 70 ocean, river, and lake ports with a focus on efficient and sustainable freight solutions.

providers.name: Dana Incorporated
providers.description: Dana Incorporated (NYSE: DAN) is a global supplier of power-conveyance and energy-management solutions for on-highway vehicles — axles, driveshafts, transmissions, sealing and thermal products, and electrified propulsion including motors, inverters and controllers. Founded in 1904 and headquartered in Maumee, Ohio, Dana completed the divestiture of its Off-Highway business effective January 1, 2026 and now operates sixty-six major manufacturing and assembly plants plus seven aftermarket sales and service facilities across 24 countries. Dana's public API surface was the Dana Aftermarket developer platform announced in June 2021 — eight APIs for advanced shipping notification, availability, deep linking, order status, part details, part search by application, place order and pricing. As of 2026-09-07 both that portal (developer.danaaftermarket.com) and its API host (api.danaaftermarket.com) return NXDOMAIN; the only anonymously reachable machine-readable documents Dana serves are the OpenID Connect discovery, OAuth authorization-server metadata and JWKS on www.dana.com, which secure the site's Optimizely CMS rather than a product API. This repository is an alias of the primary "dana" profile.

providers.name: Delek US
providers.description: Delek US is an alias for Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK), a diversified downstream energy company headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt operations, renewable fuels, and convenience store retailing. Delek operates four refineries in Tyler and Big Spring (Texas), El Dorado (Arkansas), and Krotz Springs (Louisiana) with combined crude throughput capacity of roughly 302,000 barrels per day. The canonical profile for this company is maintained under aid delek-us-holdings; this entry exists as a name alias and references the corporate site. Delek does not publish a developer API; partner integrations occur through industry-standard EDI, terminal automation, and ticketing systems.

providers.name: Delta Air Lines
providers.description: Delta Air Lines is a major U.S. airline providing scheduled air transportation for passengers and cargo throughout the United States and across the world. Delta operates a developer API portal for partner integrations covering flight search, flight offers, customer journey, loyalty, and operations data, with an emphasis on NDC-based content distribution.

providers.name: Discover Financial Services
providers.description: Discover Financial Services is a US direct bank and payments company that owns the Discover Network, the PULSE debit network, and Diners Club International. Its Discover Global Network (DGN) developer program exposes a partner-gated developer center with interactive OpenAPI documentation for card-network products — EMV 3-D Secure (ProtectBuy), Secure Remote Commerce / Click to Pay, Stored Token Services (tokenization), and Discover Deliver push payments. Consumer account-data access is delivered through open-finance aggregators (Plaid, Finicity) rather than a first-party retail-banking API.

providers.name: Dominion Energy
providers.description: Dominion Energy is one of the nation's largest producers and transporters of energy, providing electricity and natural gas to customers across multiple U.S. states including Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, and Utah. No public developer APIs are currently published.

providers.name: Dow
providers.description: Dow Inc. is a global materials science company headquartered in Midland, Michigan. Dow combines science and technology to develop innovative products and solutions for packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications. This entry is an alias of dow-chemical and covers the same parent company.

providers.name: Energen
providers.description: Energen Corporation was a U.S. oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, with operations focused on the Permian Basin in west Texas and southeast New Mexico. In November 2018, Energen was acquired by Diamondback Energy in an all-stock transaction, and the Energen brand was retired as its assets were integrated into Diamondback. No public developer APIs are currently published; this repository preserves the corporate record.

providers.name: Energy Transfer Equity
providers.description: Energy Transfer Equity, L.P. (ETE) was a master limited partnership that owned and operated a diverse portfolio of midstream energy assets. In October 2018, ETE merged with its operating subsidiary Energy Transfer Partners (ETP) to form a single publicly traded partnership, Energy Transfer LP (NYSE: ET). All developer resources, including the Messenger+ API for pipeline messaging and gas scheduling, are now provided under the Energy Transfer LP brand.

providers.name: Expedia
providers.description: Expedia is one of the world's leading travel platforms, helping travelers plan and book trips through a portfolio of brands including Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo, Orbitz, Travelocity, Hotwire, Wotif, and trivago. Developer APIs are published under the Expedia Group developer platform; this repository serves as a brand alias pointing to the canonical expedia-group catalog.

providers.name: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS)
providers.description: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) is a global provider of financial services technology offering solutions across retail and institutional banking, payments, asset and wealth management, risk and compliance, and outsourcing. FIS exposes APIs to financial institutions, fintechs, and corporates through its Code Connect API marketplace.

providers.name: First Horizon Corporation
providers.description: First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN), headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, is a regional financial-services holding company operating across 12 southeastern U.S. states through its principal subsidiary, First Horizon Bank. The franchise reports roughly $84 billion in total assets, $67 billion in deposits, and approximately 410 banking centers as of Q1 2026. Business lines include consumer and small-business banking, commercial and specialty lending, private banking and wealth management, and FHN Financial fixed- income capital markets. The company was founded in 1864 as First National Bank of Memphis, rebranded as First Tennessee in 1977, became First Horizon National Corporation in 2004, and shortened its name to First Horizon Corporation following the 2020 IberiaBank merger. In February 2022 First Horizon announced a $13.4 billion all-cash acquisition by Toronto-Dominion Bank; the parties mutually terminated the merger on May 4, 2023, citing regulatory uncertainty around the deal's closing timeline, with TD paying a $225 million termination fee plus a previously agreed $25 million reimbursement to First Horizon. First Horizon does not publish a public developer API portal. Customer account data is reachable for fintech use cases only through US open-banking aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and through emerging Financial Data Exchange (FDX) APIs that will be required of covered data providers under the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule. Commercial APIs for treasury management, ACH origination, wire initiation, and host-to-host file transfer are available to corporate clients under direct contract through First Horizon Treasury Management Services but are not publicly documented.

providers.name: Fluor Corporation
providers.description: A multinational engineering and construction firm providing design, procurement, construction, and maintenance services. Serves energy, chemicals, mining, infrastructure, and government sectors with large-scale capital project expertise.

providers.name: FMC Corporation

providers.description: Fox Corporation (NASDAQ: FOXA, FOX) is a US media company spun out of 21st Century Fox in 2019 when the rest of the business was sold to Disney. Per the company website, "Fox Corporation produces and distributes compelling news, sports, and entertainment content through its primary iconic domestic brands" — Fox News Media (Fox News Channel, Fox Business Network, Fox News Digital, Fox News Audio, Fox Weather), Fox Sports (FS1, FS2, Big Ten Network, Fox Deportes, Fox Bet partnerships), Fox Entertainment, Fox Television Stations, and the Tubi Media Group (Tubi free ad-supported streaming, Credible). In May 2024 Fox acquired Mexican sports-betting and casino operator Caliente.mx, expanding its sports-and-wagering footprint into Latin America. Fox does not publish a public developer portal or REST API surface for the parent corporation — programmatic distribution is delivered via per-brand RSS / Atom feeds (Fox News, Fox Business, Fox Sports, Fox Weather), the Tubi Media Group open source projects on GitHub (github.com/Tubitv, 53 public repositories), and direct B2B advertising and content-syndication relationships rather than self-serve API signup. Founded in 1900, the company provides life insurance, supplemental health insurance, and annuity products through direct-to-consumer and agent distribution channels across the United States. Subsidiaries include Globe Life Liberty National Division, American Income Life Insurance Company, United American Insurance Company, Globe Life And Accident Insurance Company, and Globe Life Family Heritage Division. Revenue in 2024 was $5.78 billion with total assets of $29.1 billion. No public developer API is available; the company uses MuleSoft Anypoint Platform internally for API management and integration.

providers.name: Hesi
providers.description: Hesi (合思, operated by Beijing Hosi Information Technology Co., Ltd.) is an AI-driven spend and expense management SaaS platform founded in 2014 and backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund. Its cloud platform covers intelligent expense control and reimbursement ("no expense reports needed"), corporate business-travel booking, AI-powered audit and approval, electronic accounting archives, accounts payable/receivable, and business-intelligence analytics. Hesi serves 7,000+ paid enterprises — including large corporations and Fortune 500 firms across China — and runs a PaaS platform with integrations to roughly 1,400 banks. The company operates R&D centers in Beijing, Hangzhou, and Nanchang with 22 direct service offices nationwide.

providers.name: Hess

providers.name: Hub

Data is sourced through a global network of 500,000+ retail contributors and verified small and medium businesses across 150+ countries and 100+ languages. Hub offers both off-the-shelf labeled datasets and bespoke, custom-scoped data collection projects quoted within hours, delivered through a fully managed pipeline that couples automation with human-in-the-loop validation for frontier AI labs and Fortune 500 companies.

providers.name: Jabil

providers.name: JetBlue Airways

providers.name: John Deere

Through its Operations Center and Precision Tech developer programs, John Deere exposes APIs that allow authorized partners and customers to access organization, field, machine, field operations, and webhook data tied to connected equipment and farm management workflows.

providers.name: Joinmidi
providers.description: Joinmidi (Midi Health) is a virtual care company for women in midlife, providing insurance-covered telehealth from women's health specialists across all 50 states. Its clinicians deliver personalized, evidence-based care for perimenopause and menopause plus weight management, sexual wellness, mood, sleep, hair and skin health, and cancer survivorship, backed by custom prescription medications (Midi Custom Rx) and a targeted supplement line. Midi is NCQA accredited, works with major insurance plans, and partners with health systems and Fortune 100 employers as a covered benefit. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer or API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Kellogg
providers.description: The Kellogg Company is a historic American multinational food manufacturer founded in 1906 by W.K. Kellogg in Battle Creek, Michigan. In 2023 the company split into two independent public companies: WK Kellogg Co, which retained the North American cereal business (Frosted Flakes, Rice Krispies, Special K, Corn Flakes, Raisin Bran), and Kellanova, which took the global snacks business and international cereal portfolio (Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, Eggo, RXBAR). This profile tracks the legacy Kellogg corporate identity and links forward to the two successor entities.

It operates a portfolio of more than 125 owned, licensed, partner, and allied brands across hot and cold beverages, including Keurig single-serve brewing systems and brands such as Dr Pepper, 7UP, Snapple, Mott's, Bai, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, and Peet's Coffee.

providers.name: Liberty Energy
providers.description: Liberty Energy Inc (NYSE: LBRT), formerly Liberty Oilfield Services, is a Denver-based energy services company. It is one of the largest providers of completion services (hydraulic fracturing, wireline, sand and logistics) to onshore oil, natural gas, and enhanced geothermal producers in North America, and it is rapidly pivoting into distributed power generation for data centers and AI infrastructure via its Liberty Power Innovations (LPI) subsidiary. Founded in 2011 by Chris Wright, who left in 2025 to become the 17th US Secretary of Energy under the Trump administration. Ron Gusek is now President and CEO. The company does not publish any public developer APIs; this profile documents the organization, its proprietary internal platforms (FracTrends, Sentinel, digiTechnologies), and the Liberty Power data center pivot.

Controlled by the Tisch family, the corporation pursues long-term shareholder value through four operating subsidiaries spanning insurance, energy infrastructure, hospitality, and rigid plastic packaging. This apis.yml therefore documents the parent's portfolio structure and points to each operating subsidiary for any API-bearing surface.

providers.name: Newfront Insurance
providers.description: Newfront is a technology-native insurance brokerage ("a brokerage for the 21st century") serving startups through Fortune 500 enterprises, and now part of WTW. It places business insurance (property, casualty, cyber, executive risk, workers' compensation, surety, aviation, M&A and global programs) alongside Total Rewards services (employee benefits, compensation, retirement/401(k), HR, payroll and benefits compliance), pairing brokerage expertise with in-house software such as the Navigator benefits platform, RiskPulse analytics, and contract/coverage-gap review tools. Newfront reports roughly 20% of U.S. unicorns as clients and $3.1B in annual premiums placed. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks; client and employee interaction happens through the authenticated app.newfront.com application. providers.name: Oracle Health (Cerner)
providers.description: Oracle Health, formerly Cerner, builds and operates Millennium — one of the two dominant electronic health record platforms in United States hospitals and health systems. Cerner was acquired by Oracle in June 2022 and its developer program now runs as the Oracle Health Developer Program. The public developer surface is HL7 FHIR R4: a multi-tenant, US Core-conformant FHIR server that serves a live CapabilityStatement at /metadata and a live SMART on FHIR discovery document at /.well-known/smart-configuration, advertising 303 OAuth scopes across patient, user and system personas in both SMART v1 and SMART v2 granular forms. It supports SMART App Launch (EHR and standalone), SMART Backend Services with private_key_jwt, FHIR Bulk Data Access export, and — unusually — an open, unauthenticated, read-only endpoint that serves real sandbox data with no registration at all. Alongside FHIR it operates proprietary Millennium EHR APIs, HL7 v2 messaging through Cerner Open Interface, and the CareAware device and integration platform. There is no OpenAPI, no GraphQL endpoint, no MCP server, no agent card, no published pricing, no published rate limits, no status page and no first-party SDK for the FHIR API.

providers.name: Oscar Health

Leveraging AI‑driven agents, Panaya automates test creation, impact analysis, custom code correction, and test execution for SAP, Oracle, Salesforce and other critical systems, reducing risk and accelerating delivery. The company serves thousands of users worldwide, including many Fortune 500 firms, and offers a cloud‑based solution with extensive integration capabilities and a developer portal for APIs and documentation.

providers.name: Progressive Insurance
providers.description: One of the largest auto insurance providers in the United States offering personal auto, motorcycle, boat, RV, home, renters, and commercial insurance. Progressive is known for its direct-to-consumer model (1-800-PROGRESSIVE and progressive.com), its independent-agent channel, the comparative rate quoting experience, and the Snapshot usage-based insurance program that prices premiums against telematics-captured driving behaviour from a plug-in OBD-II dongle or the Snapshot mobile app. Progressive also runs the ForAgents agent portal and a public Developer Portal at developer.progressive.com that hosts embedded-quoting APIs for partners — including the Embedded Direct auto quoting API, the Commercial Auto Quoting product, and the Certificate of Insurance API — alongside private B2B integrations with comparative-rater carriers, agency-management systems, and telematics providers.

In October 2016, Quintiles merged with IMS Health to form IQVIA, a leading provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions, and contract research services to the life sciences industry. The legacy Quintiles entity no longer operates as an independent company and does not maintain a public API program; all developer-facing capabilities are now part of IQVIA.

providers.name: Ralph Lauren Corporation
providers.description: Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE: RL) is a global premium-lifestyle company founded by Ralph Lauren in 1967 and headquartered in New York City. The company designs, markets, and distributes apparel, accessories, home, and fragrances across a portfolio of brands including Polo Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Double RL (RRL), Lauren Ralph Lauren, and Chaps, along with Polo Golf, RLX, Pink Pony, Ralph Lauren Home and Paint, Ralph Lauren Watches and Fine Jewelry, and Ralph Lauren Restaurants. Direct-to-consumer commerce runs on Adobe Commerce, and category-extension brands are operated through licensing partners (eyewear via Luxottica, fragrances via L'Oréal). The corporation operates retail stores in dozens of countries with no publicly documented developer APIs, partner program portal, affiliate API, or open OpenAPI/Postman/GraphQL surface as of the profiling date.

Realogy Holdings does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are managed through brand-specific technology platforms and partner programs.

providers.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is a leading biotechnology company that invents, develops, and commercializes life-transforming medicines for people with serious diseases in eye disease, cancer, inflammation, infectious disease, and rare diseases. The Regeneron Genetics Center (RGC) is a wholly owned subsidiary that has sequenced over 3 million human exomes and pioneered the use of large-scale genomics to discover and validate drug targets. Regeneron open-sources bioinformatics tools including regenie (whole genome regression), CLAMMS (CNV detection), and TCRAI (T-cell receptor analysis) through its GitHub organizations at github.com/rgcgithub and github.com/regeneron-mpds.

providers.description: Reinsurance Group of America (RGA) is a leading global provider of life and health reinsurance and financial solutions, serving clients in more than 70 countries. (NYSE: RS) is the largest metals service center operator in North America, distributing approximately 100,000 metal products across aluminum, brass, alloy, copper, carbon steel, stainless steel, titanium, and specialty metals to over 125,000 customers including fabricators and manufacturers. Operating under more than 75 distinct brands across 300+ locations in the US, Canada, and internationally, Reliance provides value-added processing services including cutting, shearing, sawing, leveling, stamping, and just-in-time delivery for aerospace, automotive, construction, defense, energy, electronics, and semiconductor end markets.

providers.name: S&P Global
providers.description: S&P Global is a leading provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics, and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity, and automotive markets. Through its divisions — S&P Global Market Intelligence, S&P Global Ratings, S&P Global Commodity Insights, S&P Global Mobility, and S&P Dow Jones Indices — the company delivers data, analytics, and decisioning capabilities to financial institutions, corporations, governments, and individuals worldwide. S&P Global APIs enable programmatic access to financial data, market prices, energy market data, credit ratings, and geospatial intelligence.

providers.name: S&P Global
providers.description: S&P Global is a leading provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics, and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity, and automotive markets. S&P Global offers multiple API product lines across its business divisions: the Capital IQ API provides comprehensive financial and market intelligence data; the Commodity Insights API provides price assessments, market data, and analytics for energy and commodities markets; and the Marketplace API enables programmatic access to the S&P Global data marketplace catalog.

providers.name: Salesforce
providers.description: Salesforce is a global leader in customer relationship management (CRM) software and cloud-based applications. The Salesforce Platform provides a comprehensive suite of APIs for sales, service, marketing, commerce, integration, analytics, and platform development including Agentforce AI capabilities.

providers.name: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC)
providers.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is a Reston, Virginia based technology integrator that delivers mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services to U.S. federal civilian, defense, intelligence community, and space customers. With approximately 24,000 employees and roughly $7.3 billion in annual revenue, SAIC focuses on direct technical support and integration for government organizations, spanning CJADC2, data and AI, digital transformation, quantum technologies, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, digital engineering, and systems integration. SAIC has expanded its capabilities through acquisitions including Engility (2018), Unisys Federal (2020), Halfaker (2021, DoD healthcare), Koverse (2021, secure data lake for classified environments), and Forfeiture Support Associates (2023). No public REST APIs, developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or open source GitHub organization have been identified for SAIC — its software and platforms are delivered under federal contract to government customers rather than as externally-consumable developer products.

providers.name: Securian Financial
providers.description: Securian Financial Group is a Saint Paul, Minnesota-based mutual holding company offering life insurance, annuities, institutional retirement solutions, trust services, investment management and group workplace benefits to individuals, employers, financial institutions and institutional clients across the United States and Canada. Its operating companies include Minnesota Life Insurance Company, Securian Life Insurance Company, Securian Asset Management and Securian Canada. Securian does not run a public developer program: its integration surfaces are partner-facing and sales-gated. Securian Platform Connect exchanges benefits data with employer benefits-administration platforms using LIMRA LDEx standards (Evidence of Insurability and Benefits Enrollment Management) plus SSO, API notifications and file feeds, and FlexTech - launched March 2026 with Walnut - embeds payment protection into digital lending journeys through API-based integration. Neither publishes a machine-readable contract, developer portal or self-service onboarding.

providers.name: Sierra
providers.description: Sierra is a conversational AI platform for customer experience, founded in 2023 by Bret Taylor (former co-CEO of Salesforce, CTO of Facebook, co-creator of Google Maps, and current chair of OpenAI's board) and Clay Bavor (former Google VP who led Labs, Project Starline, Google Lens, and Google Workspace). Headquartered in New York with offices in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, Paris, Madrid, Toronto, Singapore, and Tokyo, Sierra builds branded AI agents that handle customer service, sales, and operational interactions across chat, voice, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and ChatGPT for enterprises including SiriusXM, WeightWatchers, Sonos, ADT, Chime, Sutter Health, Rocket Mortgage, Ramp, Brex, SoFi, Casper, CLEAR, Vivid Seats, Wayfair, AOL, and approximately 40% of the Fortune 50. The platform is anchored by Agent OS 2.0, with Agent Studio (no-code builder for CX teams), Agent SDK (a developer-facing programmatic layer that lets engineering teams write customer journeys as code), Agent Data Platform (persistent cross-session memory unifying structured CRM data and unstructured conversation history), Insights (analytics — Explorer, Monitors, Experiments, Observability), Live Assist (human-in-the-loop), Voice (real-time voice agents), and Ghostwriter (an agent-building agent that generates production-ready multilingual agents from SOPs, transcripts, audio recordings, whiteboard photos, or plain English in 30+ languages). Sierra runs an outcome-based pricing model — customers pay per resolved case, not per seat or per token — and operates a gated developer documentation portal at docs.sierra.ai available only to contracted customers. There is no public REST API, no public Agent SDK package, no public GitHub org, and no self-serve sign-up; access is via enterprise sales. Sierra raised $950M at a $15.8B valuation in May 2026 (after a $350M round at $10B earlier in the year) and reported $150M ARR within roughly two years of public launch. Sierra also acquired the French agent-evaluation startup Fragment in April 2026 and publishes the public τ-bench, τ-voice, and τ-knowledge benchmarks for evaluating agentic systems.

providers.name: Sierra Ventures
providers.description: Sierra Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded by Peter Wendell in 1982 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, in the heart of Silicon Valley. The firm invests from inception through Series A in first-principles founders under the tagline "Conviction Before Consensus," writing checks of up to $5M at seed and up to $10M at Series A. Sierra's current investment thesis centers on the next wave of enterprise technology: Vertical AI (purpose-built AI for specific industries), Infrastructure AI, Frontier and Deep Tech, and Physical AI and Robotics, alongside a longstanding history in enterprise applications, digital health, SaaS, and security. Over its 40-plus-year history the firm has invested more than $2 billion across 13 early-stage funds, with its 13th fund closing in 2023 at $265 million, following Fund 12 at $215 million and Fund 11 at $170 million. Sierra reports 35 IPOs and hundreds of successful exits, having backed companies such as Elastic, Astronomer, Chronosphere, CourseHero, Q-CTRL, Spectro Cloud, Endor Labs, and Reflection AI. The firm is notable for its CXO Advisory Board of Fortune 1000 enterprise leaders who help portfolio companies land early customers. This profile tracks Sierra Ventures' identity and its portfolio graph across the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sirius XM Holdings
providers.description: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: SIRI) is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, operating a portfolio of subscription, ad-supported streaming, podcast, and advertising-technology businesses. Its flagship satellite radio service SiriusXM serves roughly 33 million paid subscribers, while Pandora delivers ad-supported and premium music streaming to approximately 40 million active users. The portfolio also includes podcast network Simplecast, programmatic audio adtech platform AdsWizz, audio sales arm SiriusXM Media, and Pandora AMP. SiriusXM Holdings was split off from Liberty Media in September 2024, becoming an independent publicly traded company. This holdings-level index points to the operating subsidiaries; the consolidated developer surface is profiled in the `sirius-xm` repository, with no separate corporate developer program at the holding-company level.

providers.name: State Farm Insurance
providers.description: State Farm Insurance refers to the primary insurance operations of State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company and its affiliated entities, headquartered in Bloomington, Illinois. As the largest property and casualty insurer in the United States, State Farm Insurance provides auto, home, renters, life, health, commercial, and farm insurance products to over 83 million policies across 91 million accounts. The company operates through approximately 19,000 exclusive agents and has a robust digital platform. State Farm Insurance maintains a Partner Gateway developer portal (developer.statefarm.com) offering APIs for embedded insurance, partner integrations, and B2B connectivity. The company has also heavily invested in cloud infrastructure on AWS and has open-sourced numerous DevOps and infrastructure tools via its GitHub organization.

providers.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
providers.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment. The company operates through its publishing labels: Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption), 2K (NBA 2K, Borderlands, Civilization, BioShock, Mafia), Private Division, and Zynga (mobile games). Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two is a Fortune 500 company with studios across North America, Europe, and Asia. No public developer API is currently available.

providers.name: TD Ameritrade Holding
providers.description: TD Ameritrade Holding Corporation was a brokerage firm that provided online brokerage and related services for individual investors. The company was acquired by Charles Schwab in 2020 and the TD Ameritrade platform was fully migrated to Charles Schwab in May 2024. TD Ameritrade offered a developer API for programmatic access to trading, account management, market data, and order management capabilities. The successor API is now the Charles Schwab Trader API at developer.schwab.com.

providers.name: Tesla Motors
providers.description: Tesla, Inc. (formerly Tesla Motors, Inc.) is an American electric vehicle and clean energy company that designs and manufactures electric cars, battery energy storage systems, solar panels, and related products. The Tesla Owner API provides programmatic access to Tesla vehicles for monitoring state, controlling climate, locking/unlocking doors, managing charging, and executing remote commands.

providers.name: The Campbell's Company
providers.description: The Campbell's Company (formerly Campbell Soup Company) is an American manufacturer and marketer of branded convenience food products including soups, simple meals, beverages, and snacks. Major brands include Campbell's, Rao's, V8, Pace, Pepperidge Farm, Snyder's of Hanover, Lance, Cape Cod, Kettle Brand, Goldfish, and Prego. The company operates consumer-facing digital properties, an investor relations portal, a careers platform, and supplier resources, but does not publish general-purpose public APIs.

providers.name: The Travelers Companies
providers.description: The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV) is a leading United States property and casualty (P&C) insurance carrier providing auto, home, and business insurance to individuals, agencies, businesses, government units, and associations. Travelers is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, generated approximately $48.83 billion in revenue in 2025, holds roughly $143.7 billion in total assets, and employs approximately 34,000 people plus 15,000 independent agents and brokers across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Republic of Ireland. The company operates through three reportable segments — Business Insurance, Bond & Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance — distributing primarily through a network of independent agents and brokers, and through direct-to-consumer channels for segments of its personal lines. Travelers has a developer portal at developer.travelers.com that surfaces APIs intended for appointed agents, agency-management-system (AMS) vendors, and integration partners; the portal is gated (Salesforce Experience Cloud) and individual API specifications, endpoints, and pricing are not publicly published. The company also publishes the IntelliDrive and IntelliDrivePlus telematics mobile apps used to score personal-auto driving behavior for rating credits.

providers.name: Tiffany & Co.
providers.description: An iconic American luxury jewelry and specialty retailer known for its diamond engagement rings and signature blue boxes. A subsidiary of LVMH operating flagship stores and boutiques in major cities around the world.

providers.name: Tri Pointe Homes
providers.description: Tri Pointe Homes (NYSE: TPH) is a US homebuilder headquartered in Orange County, California. Founded in 2009, it builds single-family and multifamily new homes across 13 states plus the District of Columbia under a unified Tri Pointe Homes brand that consolidated legacy regional brands including Pardee Homes, Maracay, Quadrant Homes, Winchester Homes, and Trendmaker Homes. The company also offers ancillary services through Tri Pointe Connect (mortgage), Tri Pointe Assurance (title and escrow), and Tri Pointe Advantage (insurance). Tri Pointe operates no public developer program, no documented API, and no GitHub presence; its digital surface is limited to a marketing site (tripointehomes.com), an investor portal, a blog, and a careers portal.

providers.name: Trimble Navigation
providers.description: Trimble Navigation Limited (now Trimble Inc.) is a global technology company founded in 1978 that pioneered commercial GPS technology. Trimble develops positioning, navigation, and geospatial solutions spanning construction, agriculture, transportation, and surveying industries. The company rebranded from Trimble Navigation Limited to Trimble Inc. in 2016. Its developer APIs cover GPS/GNSS positioning through Trimble Mobile Manager, high-accuracy survey integration via the Trimble Precision SDK, and geospatial data services. The positioning technology integrates GPS, laser, optical, and inertial technologies to deliver centimeter-level accuracy for professional applications.

providers.name: TriNet
providers.description: TriNet is a Dublin, California-based professional employer organization (PEO) for small and mid-market businesses, founded in 1988 by Martin Babinec and led today by President and CEO Mike Simonds. TriNet delivers full-service HR through a co-employment model — payroll processing, Fortune-500-grade health, retirement and ancillary benefits, workers' compensation, employment-practices liability coverage, compliance and risk management, and strategic HR advisory — to thousands of SMBs across the United States. The company offers two main packages: TriNet PEO (full co-employment) and HR Plus (technology platform plus support). TriNet is publicly traded on the NYSE as TNET with trailing-twelve-month revenue of roughly $5.0B as of FY2025. TriNet exposes its HR Customer Platform through three SwaggerHub-documented API groups — DCP, HRIS, and PEO — covering Employees, Companies, Payroll, Money, and Time-Off domains, with API credentials issued to approved customers and Integration Center partners rather than offered as a fully open developer program; OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman/Insomnia collections, a sandbox, OAuth playground, and webhook management are available to authorized developers. Public 1:1 API access typically requires partner-program qualification and technical review, which is why most TriNet customers consume the platform via the curated Integration Center marketplace (accounting, HRIS, identity, ATS, payroll, benefits and learning partners) or via unified-API aggregators such as Finch, Merge, Apideck and Truto.

providers.name: UGI
providers.description: UGI Corporation (NYSE: UGI) is a King of Prussia, Pennsylvania-based natural gas and electric utility and propane distribution company. UGI Utilities serves Pennsylvania natural gas and electric customers, AmeriGas is the largest retail propane distributor in the United States, and UGI International markets LPG across Europe through brands including Antargaz, Flaga, and AvantiGas. The corporation also operates midstream and energy marketing businesses. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specs, or third-party developer APIs have been identified. Customer self-service runs on a Smart Energy Water (SEW)-powered Online Account Center (Android package com.sew.ugi) with CheckFree Pay handling bill payments; AmeriGas operates the separate MyAmeriGas portal at myamerigas.com. Large commercial customers use an Oracle APEX-based TCP platform at apex.ugi.com. UGI Utilities is not listed as a supported utility by UtilityAPI or other Green Button aggregators at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Ulta Beauty
providers.description: Ulta Beauty is the largest beauty retailer in the United States, offering cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products, and salon services through retail stores and online. The company operates over 1,400 stores across all 50 states and an e-commerce platform. Ulta Beauty does not currently offer a public developer API, but provides an affiliate program through Impact for publishers and content creators.

providers.name: UnitedHealth Group
providers.description: The largest healthcare company in the world by revenue, operating UnitedHealthcare insurance and Optum health services. Serves over 150 million people through its health benefits and technology-driven care solutions.

providers.name: Veeva Systems
providers.description: Veeva Systems is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Veeva Systems API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Verizon Communications
providers.description: Verizon Communications is one of the world's leading providers of technology and communications services, offering wireless, wireline, broadband, and global enterprise services to consumers, businesses, and government customers. Verizon exposes developer APIs for network capabilities including SIM swap detection, number verification, IoT device management via ThingSpace, 5G edge computing, contact center voice APIs, and TM Forum-certified service management APIs for enterprise customers.

providers.name: Western Alliance Bancorp.
providers.description: Western Alliance Bancorporation is a bank holding company headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, that provides commercial banking, treasury management, and specialty lending services through Western Alliance Bank. The company serves business clients across multiple regional and national specialty segments. Western Alliance Bancorp does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Westlake
providers.description: Westlake Corporation is a global Fortune 500 manufacturer and supplier of materials and innovative products that enhance life every day. The company produces chemical materials and building products across multiple sectors including packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction. Westlake operates through two primary segments: Performance and Essential Materials (PEM) and Housing and Infrastructure Products (HIP), with net sales of approximately $11 billion annually.

providers.name: Williams Companies
providers.description: The Williams Companies is an American Fortune 500 energy company focused on natural gas infrastructure, processing, and transportation. Williams owns and operates midstream energy assets including the Transco pipeline (the largest natural gas pipeline in the United States), gathering and processing systems, and storage facilities. Williams serves natural gas producers, local distribution companies, and large-volume end users. The company provides customer portal access for operational data and FERC-regulated electronic bulletin boards for capacity transactions, but does not offer public developer REST APIs.

providers.name: World Kinect
providers.description: World Kinect Corporation (NYSE: WKC), formerly World Fuel Services, is a Fortune 500 energy, commodities and services company headquartered in Doral, Florida. It supplies and manages aviation, marine and land fuel, lubricants, natural gas, power, water and carbon-management services for airlines, business aviation operators, shipping lines, commercial fleets, fuel retailers and industrial customers in more than 200 countries. Its digital surface is a family of authenticated customer portals — myWorld for aviation, land, marine and carbon management, World Kinect Online for energy services, and the Flyers Energy and Quick Fuel Vantage/Advantage portals — plus a fuel-price and AVCARD integration that reaches operators through third-party flight-operations platforms. World Kinect publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: XPO
providers.description: XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO) is a Fortune 500 transportation company and one of the largest providers of less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation in North America. Following the spin-offs of GXO Logistics (contract logistics, 2021) and RXO (brokerage, 2022), XPO is now a pure-play LTL trucking company operating a network of service centers across the United States and Mexico. XPO does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; customer integrations (rate quotes, shipment tracking, EDI) are arranged through enterprise account managers and standard EDI exchanges.
